title: Momoi Airi — Card Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Middle School Student A
rows.Line: Excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Middle School Student B
rows.Line: Are you Airi Momoi?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Middle School Student A
rows.Line:
I knew it!
Um, could you shake hands with me, please?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, but I'm no longer...
Oh!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is that keychain on your bag...?

rows.Speaker: Middle School Student A
rows.Line:
Yes!
We bought it when we went to your show last year!

rows.Speaker: Middle School Student B
rows.Line: We're huge fans of yours, so we both got the same keychain but in different colors!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I see. They don't see me as a variety show talent, but a proper idol...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess it can't be helped. Specially for you, okay?

rows.Speaker: Middle School Student A & B
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, thank YOU for your support!

rows.Speaker: Middle School Student A
rows.Line: By the way, you're in Miyamasuzaka Girls, the same school that Shizuku from Cheerful * Days is also attending, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, but why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: Middle School Student B
rows.Line: Then that was definitely Shizuku just now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you met Shizuku too?

rows.Speaker: Middle School Student B
rows.Line: No, we just caught sight of her. The situation didn't seem too good so we didn't call out to her... I hope everything's okay now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, can you tell me what happened?
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They said it was around here... Ah! There she is!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Ugh... Waaaaaah haah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um... It's okay. Where's your mommy?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I don't think I'm doing this right...
How can I get her to stop crying?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What are you doing, Shizuku?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi!
Well, this little girl was crying, so I...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I can see that.
Nevermind, let me handle this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
There, there. Why are you crying?
Did something scary happen?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Don't worry, we'll help you!
But you need to calm down first and tell us what happened, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Ah... She's slowly calming down from the bawling...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right, you got lost, huh? And you've been trying hard to handle it all by yourself. But you'll be fine now with us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, thank goodness... She stopped crying.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know! How about I sing a happy song for you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here goes!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I saw that song on TV before!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Huh?
I've seen you and the other lady on TV before too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, we often sing this song on music programs... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, look. That woman's running towards us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Maybe she's...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Mommy!

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: Thank goodness! I was looking all over for you!

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for the trouble my child was causing...
Huh? A-Aren't you both idols?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Yeah, it's really obvious if we don't disguise ourselves.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, that's us. But please don't worry about it.
We couldn't ignore a crying child, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: I'm really grateful that you helped my daughter out. Come on, say thank you too.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Thank you, idol ladies!
And bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Bye bye...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew, at any rate, I'm just glad she found her mother.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You're amazing, Airi.
I wasn't able to do anything at all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, I'm quite used to dealing with kids since I have a younger sister.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, you have a younger sister too.
You've never had to comfort her before?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's only one year younger, so I've actually not seen her cry before.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's strong...unlike me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Did you say something?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, didn't you have a job today?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Ah, right. I have to go now.
I'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You stick to it, Shizuku.
Especially since you're being allowed to do proper idol activities...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, substitute the X here with a 3, and then...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Ugh, this practical exercise is so hard...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(What? Her pen's on the table?
Does that mean she's already solved the question?!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I need to hurry up!)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay, for this question... Momoi.
Come out and solve it for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: O-Okay!
After class

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... I'm glad I got it right even though I wasn't sure!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Did Shizuku solve that question too?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, what's this?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? What's what?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've only written down the questions in your notebook!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Doesn't look like you've solved any of them or written down any of the answers on the blackboard either!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, I didn't really understand the questions, so...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look, even if you didn't understand, you should've at least copied down what was on the blackboard! How are you going to review the exercises now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ah, you're right. I should... Oh. They've been erased.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, you... Here, take my notebook and copy what I have.
Hurry up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm giving it to you because I am, duh!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah, just copy it quickly.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I will! Um...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This becomes this...because of this?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Why do you keep stopping?
Just copy what you see!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But it won't be proper studying if I don't understand why this formula is being used here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's just so like you, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This one becomes like this... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Maybe it's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seriously! This is annoying!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The correct way is to apply this to this part here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then calculate it like this and you'll get the answer.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I see... So that's how to make it work!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Understand now?
Then finish copying the rest of the questions quickly!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay! Apply this here...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And then use this on...huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh... Fine, I get it. I'll teach you, so stop staring at me with those puppy eyes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What? I had puppy eyes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's what I saw! Anyway, here, stare at this notebook if you have to stare at something!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're really such a handful.
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe! A new issue of the major idol mag I've been waiting for is coming out today! But first...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This magazine has a feature on newcomer idols. That's going on my reading list too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, hold on... But this one comes with a neat poster featuring high school idols in casual clothing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The solution to this difficult choice is to...buy both!
Um... Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh? Are you one of my fans?
Don't be shy, if you want a handshake or a photo of me, you can just ask...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, it's just you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew, I didn't mistake someone else for you. Airi, you look different today. I didn't immediately recognize you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wear a disguise so that I don't attract unwanted attention!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why aren't you in disguise?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do I need it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure you do! Especially with your height, people's eyes are naturally drawn to you...

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line: Look, doesn't that girl look familiar?

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line: Huh, is that Shizuku Hinomori? I can't believe it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (There it starts. People have noticed her!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Uh, at least stick your head in a magazine and pretend you're reading...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Aw, this title brings back memories.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They sometimes published articles about us when we were still rookies, remember?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
How could I forget.
But it was you who got us in the spotlight...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Forget that! Your face!
Cover your face!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not now, Shizuku. Cover your—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, technically we're in a store, but it's still a bookstore, so maybe we should keep it down...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And who do you think triggered me?!

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line: I may be wrong, but isn't that Airi Momoi next to her?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line:
Is that her? I used to really like her.
Her reactions were very funny.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (He thought I was funny?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's just go outside before we cause a scene at the store!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...weren't you buying magazines?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'll come back later.
Shizuku, put these on for now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A hat and sunglasses? Are you letting me borrow them?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I need you to keep a low profile, so yeah.
Let's get out of here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We should be safe here.
No one followed us out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, please make sure to wear at least a basic disguise when going out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You even blew my cover by talking to me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was so happy to see you, I spoke to you without thinking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's... It's okay, if you understand why it was wrong. And I don't mind getting my mags sometime later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I had nothing else planned for today, so I'm going to head back home.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi, wait. I was going lipstick shopping.
Would you like to come with me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You could help me choose a color that'd suit me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sheesh, can't you pick it yourself?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Does it mean...you're not coming?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now you're making me feel bad.
Fine, I'll come! Count it as a favor!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hi, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for helping me choose a new lipstick. I'm loving the new color.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that?
Sure, glad I helped, and I bought one for myself too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, I have something for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For me? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: These are the magazines you were going to buy before I interrupted you at the bookstore, correct?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What, you bought them for me?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I felt I owed you this, since you couldn't get them at the time because of me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You didn't need to...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But well, since you already bought them.
You can read them with me until the teacher comes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why are you even asking me? You bought them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Both have interesting feature articles this month.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This one's about newcomers to the idol scene. I really wanted to check out all these newbies.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And here you have an article about high school idols, with a poster of them in casual clothes. That's the selling point: the rare sight of them dressed in their usual stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I've got quite a bit of history with this magazine, too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Like when they did one on you when you were in training?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Uh huh. We did a long photoshoot then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it's this one that did more for your publicity.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The other one published lots of your photos, that's true.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But this one had proper feature-length articles about you and interviews.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now that you mentioned it, yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, I mean, they also did visual campaigns, like the swimsuit shoot, since it's important to cater to the audience...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But when you debuted in your group, they did a feature on you dressed casually, and had a poster series of you playing with cats.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What, don't you remember?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm... I did something like that, didn't I...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You only vaguely remember the legendary campaign which got you so many devoted fans?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
They were even demanding to see it again.
It was huge!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? You're so well-informed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course I am! I've followed every single of your campaigns! I've trawled all the bookstores for magazines featuring you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, uh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You did all that to support me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I... I wasn't!
I was researching you for reference!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was reading about all sorts of stuff, like articles about groups which were expected to become big...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminds me about what you said when I quit being an idol before...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You said I had an aura about me, and that you couldn't bear for me to step down from the stage...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Lalalalala!
I can't hear you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You got terribly worked up about me quitting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm not listening!
This conversation is over. OVER!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can you stop looking at me like I'm your loyal fan or something?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Stop giving me that look!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four... Minori!
You're the only one not keeping up with the tempo!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Watch Shizuku, Haruka, and myself carefully.
The turn should be done at this timing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One more time from the top!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew. This should do for today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
You're just amazing, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Your body doesn't shift around unnecessarily when you're dancing, and every move you make is so crisp...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmph, of course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What did you think of my dancing?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It wasn't too bad.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, you still need more practice to get the finer details of your poses right, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Keep this up and you'll be ready for our new song release!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really?
Am I really doing okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why're you looking so unsure?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because this will be our first time singing live on TV, right? I get so nervous when I think about how I just can't make any mistakes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It doesn't matter if we're on TV or not. As long as we're performing on a stage, we can't afford to make mistakes. It's all or nothing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ugh...
Y-You're absolutely right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So stop feeling nervous and start thinking about the people who will be listening to our songs.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You'd naturally be able to perform well by doing that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wh-What is it, you two?
If you've got something to say, just spit it out!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They must be feeling so moved by your great advice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Master! Please teach me more idol secrets!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Idol secrets...
Hmph. Very well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm the best person to ask about all things idol-related!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh? Did I...
Was that a dream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Oh, right...
I fell asleep after having lunch...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (A dream about being in an idol group with Minori, Haruka, and Shizuku... What a dream that was.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh yeah!
I was supposed to go watch Minori practice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(It was just a dream. I'm not an idol anymore.
The only thing I can do now is support Minori.)

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry I'm late.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah, Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you for coming here again to help me today! I was just showing Hinomori my dance routine.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She taught me a few things, but they're all so difficult... Can you watch my dance routine too?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Very well. I'm really strict, though.
I hope you have what it takes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I do!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(I'm no longer an idol.
What I saw in my dream will never happen, but...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm allowed to help someone else with their dream, right?)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four... Minori!
You were too slow at that part!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Watch Shizuku, Haruka, and myself carefully.
The turn should be done at...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Didn't I dream about this scene before?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We'd formed an idol group and were practicing our dance routine for a TV performance of our new song...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's the same practice scene, but it's gonna take a while for us to reach the TV part in my dream.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But the part about forming a group together did come true! So I'm sure the rest of the dream will also one day...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What's the matter, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: N-Nothing!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you sure? You seemed quite pleased about something...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I said it's nothing! Come on, let's practice again. We should do that part just now one more time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Agreed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, are you ready?
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Stop.
Minori and Shizuku, your steps were a little off.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry!
I'm really bad at this part...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. This part is quite hard. Is it...like this?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Not quite.
The choreography for this part should be like this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: L-Like this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How was that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, no! Oh, for goodness' sake...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We should practice separately.
I'll teach Minori. Airi, you teach Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess that's for the best. Fine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank you so much, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: While we're at it, why don't we have a little competition? Let's see which pair gets the hang of it faster.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The losing pair has to buy juice for the winning pair. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Competition?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh my...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's an interesting idea.
It'll be good motivation for both the teacher and student.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. I used to have these little competitions with the other members of ASRUN, too, in the past.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Nobody likes to lose, so you'll learn a lot faster this way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ugh... Something like collective responsibility, then? I-I have to buck up!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm counting on you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes!
And I'm counting on you too, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let's give this our best shot, Shizuku!
As former idols, we can't let Minori beat us so easily!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're too laid-back! Put some spirit into it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You have natural talent and look better on stage than anyone else, so get those dance moves right, you hear?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, what's so funny?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I just remembered that you encouraged me like this too, when I was still an idol trainee.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The people around would say looks were my only strength because I couldn't dance very well during practice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Whereas you would just scold me like you did just now. I was really happy you did...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Th-That did happen...
I've had to babysit you since such a long time ago, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for always doing that, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Heh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Shizuku's not just about looks.
She has the disposition and talent to become an amazing idol.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And she puts in a lot of hard work to make that come true. That's why I viewed her as a rival I had to beat.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm the one getting pushed to become better by you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Did you just say something?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nope!
Come on, let's start practicing now!
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see, where's my notebook... I thought I put it inside this box. And the magazines should at the back of the bookshelf, I think?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I never thought the notes I kept from when I was still in QT would come in handy one day...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? The magazines aren't on the bookshelf. But I definitely put them here... Or did I store them in a box too?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ugh... I don't even know where I put what anymore...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Looks like I just have to sort this all out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll start with this box and... Hey, this hairpiece is from one of our release events!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And the autograph on this CD! It's the one I messed up during that event!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(I was so nervous that I signed it wrong.
Hehe, sure brings back memories...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm, and this box... Ah! The idol merch that I collected a long time ago!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which means, that CD should be somewhere around...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Rainbow Garland... The CD by the first idol I became a fan of!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... The autograph I got during the meet and greet is still in good shape too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe. I was a wild tomboy that got into fights every day back then, but I dressed up nicely just for that occasion.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I desperately kept trying to catch a glimpse of them by standing on my toes as I stood in line with my CD in hand...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was so nervous too... Oh, the nostalgia...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I sort of felt that same excitement when I saw Rin's show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Between Rin and this CD, it really feels like I'm ready to restart...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's do this!
The next morning
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Morning!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, wait... It's still way too early, so of course the others aren't here yet.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe. I brought Rainbow Garland along today.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll use it to do some warm-ups before the others get here.... And, play!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One, two, three, four... And turn...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I did this routine so many times when I was in elementary school, my body still remembers it.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? Airi?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I heard music and thought someone might be here already. Have you already started practicing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Were you waiting that long...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nah, I just got here a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I found an old CD while I was cleaning my room yesterday and was using some of its songs for warm-up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, Airi...!
This is Rainbow Garland, right?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Wait, how did you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I really loved this song too♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really?! The truth is, the idol who sang this song was the very first idol I became a fan of.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! So you really looked up to this idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well... They were more of a kick-starter as opposed to how much Haruka means to you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But because of this idol, I started to learn about and like a lot of other idols.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But yeah... If this idol never came into my life, I guess I wouldn't be here today...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, when I was little, I was always picking fights with bullies in my neighborhood.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: F-Fights?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it... You told me something like that before when you were just starting out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There was this boy who kept picking on Airi's little sister.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And that was why she kept getting into those fights. It's very you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Just so you know, I never lost! Not even once!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha, and that's so like you too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Say, Airi... I'd like to try dancing to that song too. Would you mind if I joined you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh? Uh, sure but...
Why?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because it's full of fond memories for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. And trying to learn dance moves on the spot would make for good practice too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right... In that case, shall we dance?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes! And I still remember some of it too.
I think this part was...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something like this...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Stop, that's not it!
You're legs and waist aren't doing anything!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Watch, okay? We're gonna do this right. First, use your waist to get into rhythm! Then you swing your arms along while moving your feet!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! It looks so much more polished!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course it does!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now! I hope you're all ready!
I'm not going easy on any of you!
Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Humhumhuuum♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Man, this song has fantastic lyrics! The melody too...! You can't help but smile while listening to it!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, what are you listening to today?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, Shizuku. Wanna listen?
Here, take one of my earphones.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it's Rin! I was assumed you were listening to another idol group...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've been trying to listen to more songs by VIRTUAL SINGERS lately.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
Any reasons why?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Does it have to do with meeting Miku and Rin in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've known about VIRTUAL SINGERS and the that they've got some great songs, but never really took the time to actually listen...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After meeting Rin and Miku, I got to thinking that maybe the VIRTUAL SINGERS and us idols aren't all that different.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: True. Especially since Miku and Rin are both idols too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right... The Miku and Rin we met in SEKAI are idols like us, but it's not just because of that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think the VIRTUAL SINGERS that most people are familiar with are like idols too, in a way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ah, I understand what you mean! Hehe. There are so many different versions of Miku, it's hard to keep track of them all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you sure you really understand...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But what did you mean when you said the VIRTUAL SINGERS are like idols?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well... You remember what we learned in English class the other day? That the word idol comes from the word icon.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And how they are people that command the admiration and respect of others...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup. So based on that literal meaning...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: An idol doesn't have to belong to an agency, perform on a stage or even appear on TV to be considered a real idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That may be true...
But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know... That sort of idol would be very different from what people generally expect an idol to be.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If MORE MORE JUMP! can't make it by being what people generally expect and idol to be then...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm prepared to abandon being a conformist completely.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As long as the four of us are together... I really believe that we can become idols as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, sorry... I was on a roll there, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, it's okay. I'm happy to know that you've been thinking so seriously about this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, the future of MORE MORE JUMP! is on the line here. It's the least I can do!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, our goal right now is to find the best way for us to actually be idols!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! And we'll definitely find it... Together.
Diner

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, Airi! Order anything you like!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sure, thanks...
But you're really okay with paying?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course. You're the one who helped me find my answer, so think of this as a token of my appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You don't have to do all this, you know.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Well, I guess she does seem to be having fun. Plus, I can't pass up an opportunity to enjoy this Japanese sweets fair.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then I guess I'll have to take you up on your offer. But they all look so good... I don't know which one to get.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
In that case, we can just get one of each?
Excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, hold on! There's no way the two of us can eat that many!
Oh, sorry about that! Could we have just a moment please?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, these look delicious!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They sure do. Mmm... I haven't had anmitsu in quite some time. It's delicious.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This matcha parfait is really good too.
Wanna try some?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Sure. Here, you can have some of mine too.
And try this warabimochi parfait as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't mind if I do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We ended up getting a lot but it looks like we won't have any trouble finishing it all.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi. There's something that's been bothering me for a while.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? What's that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You compared me to a swan before that one time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I remember...
What about it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If I'm a swan, I was wondering what animal you would be. I've been thinking about it for some time, but I just can't seem to find the perfect fit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The perfect animal, huh? Wasn't there some fortunetelling thing that matches you to an animal?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, there was. But I can't remember where I saw it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm sure a quick search will tell us.
Now where'd my phone go?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, here it is!
How about we both give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew... That took longer than I expected!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seriously... How does it take you ten whole minutes to answer a few simple questions?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, what animal did you get?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see. It says here I'm a rhinoceros.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A rhinoceros?! Definitely not what I would've gone with, but what does it say about you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... As a rhinoceros, you are a hard worker whose strong desire to improve yourself drives you towards achieving your goals.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh. I see... That's actually pretty on the nose.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, when you have no interest in something, it shows on the surface, and you also tend to bumble around carelessly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Furthermore, you know exactly what you like or dislike and have a strongly fixate on the things you like.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I-I didn't realize...
Is this the real me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No! There's no way...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You don't think so? What does yours say, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It says that I'm a lion.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's a great animal.
They're so strong but fluffy too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess they are cats after all, so they're not completely lacking for cuteness.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... As a lion, your strong sense of justice makes you a natural leader. You also have a strong, rebellious spirit and are unbending in terms of what you believe in.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Furthermore, you also take great care when it comes to your outward appearance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wow! That's very accurate!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess so.
There's still more.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, your unyielding personality negatively affects your ability to flourish in the real world.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: An inability to compromise with others means you will have great difficulty succeeding in the workplace.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You also tend to set your expectations too high, so it may be best to reassess your goals in life.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Try your best to strive for something realistic and reachable...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A-Airi, please calm down...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I-I am calm...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Shizuku's was way off, so why is it that mine is actually somewhat accurate? This isn't funny.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There were a few questions that I wasn't sure how to answer, so maybe we can try again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, what's so funny?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You just reminded me of when we were idols-in-training. Do you remember that time we all went to visit the shrine during New Year's?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You got a fortune that said, great curse, so you kept pulling new ones until you got one that said, great blessing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
H-Hey!
Why do you remember stuff like that?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just forget about that, will you? It's definitely not something I want to remember.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? I admire how you're never dissuaded and always try to push forward, no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I thought I could learn a lot by following your example.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If that's what you want to do, then be my guest.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I will! In that case, I think I'll take the quiz one more time as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This time, I'll do my best to get something that matches perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's the example you're going to follow? And it's not really a fortune if you manipulate it to make it match...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Whatever. As long as she's having fun, I guess...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi. It looks like I won some sort of raffle.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It says, You're today's lucky winner! Answer a few easy questions and get a free appliance!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What?! W-Wait, Shizuku!
That's definitely just a scam!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see. Do I just tap here and...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
STOP! I just said that's a scam!
Quick, get away from that site!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, everyone's here!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Let's discuss our plans for the next livestream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We've come up with a lot of different ideas.
Which one do you think we should go with?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What do you think about going with Minori's idea for behind-the-scenes videos?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think it's a great idea. We never really get the chance to show those kind of things as idols, so I'm sure the fans will find it interesting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah! I thought so too!
That's why I suggested it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you actually suggested it because you want to see what Haruka's like, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hahaha... Why would I...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori...
Regardless, it's still a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I have an extra suggestion regarding this. How about we turn it into a series instead of just making it a one-time thing?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A series?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. A lot of the ideas we've had for material so far have kind of been one-and-done deals, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is great, don't get me wrong. You can watch them in any order, so it's super easy for new viewers to join at any time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I think coming up with a different idea every single time is gonna exhaust us really quickly.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Oh, you have a point...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've had plenty of these planning meetings, but it's true that our content is all starting to meld together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I was thinking the exact same thing.
Which is where this idea for a series comes in!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even variety shows on TV bring back their most popular segments over and over again, right? Think of it like that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That makes sense! But do you think we can come up with something so interesting that people will want to keep watching it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That does seem rather difficult...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't worry! I think we can make pretty much anything work as long as we decide on an overarching theme.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Maybe something like... A My First Attempt! theme. The first episode could be about cooking, the second could be sewing and stuff like that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, cooking and sewing together does actually sounds like a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is just an example, okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The goal of this series would be to have the fans get to know more about us by having a theme that lets us be ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, really? I was hoping to try a nice tofu dish with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's not the point. We can do that another time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So what do you say?
Wanna try coming up with some ideas for a series?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! But we need to come up with a theme first, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. Maybe it'll help to think of something you want to do as a group!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Something we want to do as a group...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know what I want to do.
I'd love to go to Phoenix Wonderland together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've been wanting to spend a whole day there with everyone here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You just went straight for something on your personal to-do list, huh...? Well, at least you're starting to get the idea, so keep 'em coming!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, that's a lot more than I was expecting!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This should be plenty of material to test out alongside our usual one-offs!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We can take the most popular ones and keep running with them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I feel that we could expand on some of our other videos with follow-up episodes as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. And maybe we could have a little competition to see whose idea does the best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. This is gonna be fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think so too! It's like we're really producing a show!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, that's because we are.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're making our very own channel for the fans to enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I never expected that having experience with all those variety shows would turn out to be so helpful like this.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They say you never know when a skill might come in handy. I guess they're right.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi, is that it for today's meeting?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... Why don't we go ahead and decide on an order for all of these ideas?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In other words, it'll be our program schedule. It's just as important, so let's give it some real thought!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (A joint stream, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm glad Haruka knows a lot of people but...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, thank you for waiting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're all done with committee stuff?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we are. Also, you'd like to talk here instead of in class?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, um... Can you take a look at this? It has to do with what I'd like to do for our next video...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Everything so far is getting a decent number of views, but there's one thing that's been bothering me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is this about Minori?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I sort of had a feeling this would happen, but she's really been getting short-changed...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But that's normal since we're still just starting out, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're right, but I have to think Minori sort of feels the same way regardless of how much she's smiling...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. She even watches and rewatches each video to find out where she needs to improve so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was hoping to come up with a way to show everyone that Minori has just as much to offer as the rest of us, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm hoping that we can use the joint stream Haruka set up for us can act as a sort of springboard...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, why are you grinning?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm glad that we had the same idea.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want everyone to see just how wonderful Minori is as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The same idea, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, you say that it's the same idea, but I've sort of been where she is now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I went through this long period where no one saw me as a real idol. No one wanted me around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't want her to experience what I did.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's my motive.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: More than anyone else, Minori wants to give everyone hope for tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She gave us all the courage to stand back up and become idols again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If people start to understand that, they'll all come flocking to her!

rows.Line: That's why...!

rows.Line: Whoa... I really got worked up there, didn't I?

rows.Line: I understand exactly how you feel, Airi.

rows.Line: But please let me know if you need any help, okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course! We're gonna do everything we can for her sake!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, about what I had in mind. I was thinking we could share something we're each good at...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Line: Our show was a huge success, and I was thinking we could talk about what to do next but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori's still not here. Again!

rows.Line: Yes. It's her day to care for the animals today, so she'll be running late.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Should we wait until she gets here?

rows.Line: Hehe. You're so fired up, Airi.

rows.Line: Of course I am! We put on a great show, and we're finally getting off the ground!

rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Line: I was going through the comments people posted about our show and finally found this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, they're talking about Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This person said, It's pretty amazing how she learned to dance like that in such a short amount of time, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They're starting to see just how hard she works.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They are. Honestly, there should be more people commenting on how well she did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
I found this too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Look. This is from someone's blog...

rows.Line: This person looks like they're a fan of a lot of different idols. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is the newbie idol, Minori Hanasato, there to create buzz for the group...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Including one girl who has no professional experience in the business may be a ploy to attract attention to the group.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was under this impression and believed that others may be as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, the joint stream and show they recently put on seems to prove otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The other members of the group seem to solemnly believe in her based on that performance. At least, that is now my understanding.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa, this person's got a good eye! Thank you, that's what we've been trying to say!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I'll start looking for comments and posts about Minori too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, let's all look her up online while we wait for her to get here!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Let's find as much as we can and give her the good news.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, that's not her...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... Her name alone might not be enough. Maybe a different keyword or something will...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, I know. You're not sure how to look things up, right? Here, give me your phone...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You go here and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay. Press search and...
Oh!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Look! There's a video about copying Minori's part of our dance routine!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right! Someone already posted a video like this...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, there's a comment from the poster too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They said, I keep messing up the same part! How on earth did Minori learn to do this...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. The answer is moxie, willpower and trying until you succeed!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You sound so proud of her...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hey, I found another one too.
Look, caricatures of us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, Minori's in the middle too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The person that posted this seems to be a big idol fan too. The fact that they put Minori in the middle means...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They have better eyes than all those dumb judges that kept failing Minori during her auditions!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It looks like they put a lot of effort into this too! It's almost as if they really care about her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like you're staring into a mirror, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi actually mentioned something about Minori the other day, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She said she doesn't want Minori to experience the same thing she did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She was so worried about Minori too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see, so that's why...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Why are you two grinning like that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, nothing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't mind us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That definitely means you're not telling me something...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come on, out with it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's a secret...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You are hiding something!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ugh! Just tell me already...!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks for coming today, Ena.
It was fun to actually be able to go out shopping like this with you again.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I had fun too.
I'll ask Mizuki about the picnic too and let you know once I hear back.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then I guess we'll see you for the picnic!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, see you then!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for coming along today, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it was my pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shinonome was so much fun to talk with too. Also, she's so stylish...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right? She's had an eye for fashion since junior high!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I met her just as I was starting to get more work as an idol but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That was before we became famous and didn't have other clothes besides my stage uniform. I was doing interviews in my street clothes too, but then I started talking to Ena about it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She taught me about how people viewed me and what I can do to appear more fashionable.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wasn't able to help her when she kind of really needed it. Even after she'd helped me out so much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This was during junior high too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It was the first time in a while that I was able to go to school and she said, I saw you on TV! I can't believe you really made your dream come true!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I felt so happy when she said that and I ended up saying something I shouldn't have...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I told her that, It's your turn now, Ena! As long as you work hard at it, your dreams will come true too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She just went silent after that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I asked her if something was wrong, but she said it was nothing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A while passed before I learned that she and her dad fought over what she wanted to do in life.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Those wounds still haven't really healed either...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ena was always there for me from the start, but I couldn't do anything for her...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's why I want to help her now. I have to...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's also sort of why I roped you into this, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, don't mind me. I'm the one that suggested we go on a little trip together in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It'd be my pleasure to help you and your friend out, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll be counting on you next week...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, uh oh... We haven't told Minori and Haruka that we'll be gone then!
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know I'm just dropping this on you just as our videos are finally getting more attention. I don't like taking days off out of the blue like this either...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So I'm really sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi, you don't have to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it's not like you did anything wrong!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're doing this for your friend, right?
I think it's actually really nice!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, she kind of means a lot to me.
She helped me become a real idol...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So I want to return the favor somehow...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Actually, Airi...
I have a friend like that too. We've known each other since elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You do...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't get to see her much anymore, but she was there to talk to me after I first quit, when we decided to form our group, everything...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I understand just how important someone like that can be to you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So please, do what you can for them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We're on your side, so don't worry!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Minori...
Thanks, you two...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to thank you as well!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That means it'll be just the two of us again, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... Practicing is good and all...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But what if we went somewhere together too? Like, Phoenix Wonderland maybe...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! T-T-T-Together?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. This girl from the Sports Festival Planning Committee said that she's a cast member for one of the troupes there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've been meaning to go see one of her shows, but haven't had a chance to yet...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's important that you take breaks too, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. Since we're going on a picnic, you two should go out and enjoy yourselves as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
They seem to agree...
So how about it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! If you're really alright with me going that is...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then it's settled! Let's make the most of this weekend!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, let's!
Highlands

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It really is nice to have lunch in such a beautiful place. Everything taste so much better too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. It's so different compared to when we have lunch at school together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which, you two go to the same school, right, Ena, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup, we sure do♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Does that mean you see each other at school often?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, we hardly ever see each other. Sleeping Beauty here goes to night school while I go during the day.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hah, look who's talking! You only ever go when you feel like going!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Also, we're in different grades. Ena's a second year and I'm a first year.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That means you're the same year as Akito. Have you ever met him before?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, during the School Festival! We went around and saw a bunch of stuff together♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Who's Akito?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ena's little brother.
He's pretty nice and way more mature than Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You know that's all just an act, right? He's really a big jerk that doesn't show his older sister any respect.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But he hangs out with you and even does what you ask him to do, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Like that one time you two went to that cafe I told you about just to get cheesecake. Oh, and when you went to that place with the really good pancakes but only enough for the first ten people.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. He even wakes you up in the morning when you really need him to.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's so sweet. You two must be so close.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, you're getting it all wrong...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're blushing like crazy...!
Wait, Airi, when did you first meet Ena's li'l bro?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
During junior high.
I met him when I was over at Ena's house one day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll say hi to him every once in a while, but I haven't really talked to him since that other time...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? What other time?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Oh, right...
Akito never told Ena about that...)
Back during junior high...
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ena won't tell me anything.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Every single time I ask her about what happened between her and your guys' dad, she just says, Nothing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Or even, You made your dream come true, Airi, so you keep going...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ena was a huge part of me becoming an idol, but I haven't been able to give back at all. It feels like I haven't been there for her...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know this might not sound right coming from me but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't have anyone else that I can rely on like that... I don't think Ena does either...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So please... I need you to look after her...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Ena was the reason I was able to make the most of the opportunities I was given. She gave me the courage to really go for it.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I did everything I could as an idol and regret none of it.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But then I turned around and asked Akito to do something like that after sort of just leaving Ena behind...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I haven't talked to him since then, but I guess he's still keeping his promise to me...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Ena's not the type to just let someone struggle on their own, and I guess her little brother is no different...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Airi...? Hey, Earth to Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We sort of lost you there. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, it's nothing.
I was just remembering something that happened a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Uh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I've finally just started getting back on my feet as an idol, and the way we're doing things now, I might actually be able to help Ena.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (In order to make that happen...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I need to do what I can to find out what's bothering Mizuki too!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyways, I'm stuffed.
Shall we...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. Hiking should help us walk off everything we just ate too...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and let's make sure to have as much fun as we can while we do!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka's idea worked out pretty well, didn't it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it did...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So we gotta keep coming up with stuff to make our stream better and better!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Um, Shizuku...
Are you listening?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... I'm sorry...
I was just thinking about something...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you tired? Is it because of our stream today? If so, you should rest as much as you can...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I appreciate the thought, Airi.
That's actually not what's bothering me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (So is this about Haruka...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm sure it was quite a lot of work to get this idea together, wasn't it...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Our practice went longer than usual yesterday and we all seemed to get home pretty late...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She looked so worried even after we finished our stream...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll be heading this way, so I'll see you tomorrow, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah, see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I guess I'll just keep an eye on things for now...)

A few days later
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, if you're all okay with cooking...
How about this...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This is turning into a pretty fun discussion...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Since MEIKO arrived in SEKAI, I feel like we've been able to talk things out with everyone more, yet...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Shizuku still seems worried...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, MEIKO too...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Airi, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, Luka.
Sure, what is it?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
About Shizuku...
She seems incredibly worried about Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I've noticed that too lately...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you too...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes. The idea Haruka came up with the other day went really well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But because she came up with it in just one night, Shizuku became worried that she might be pushing herself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Has there ever been a time when you thought Haruka was pushing herself too hard, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... Nothing immediately comes to mind...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That might be because Haruka's known for being a hard worker too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No matter what, she'll practice and train every day without missing a beat.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Come to think of it, she's very strict about her diet too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. I've even talked to her about finding time to relax and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But she told me that she does take breaks when she needs to.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And you believed her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, yeah. She's Haruka Kiritani, the former leader of ASRUN.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's no way she would've been able to make it that far without knowing how to balance her personal and professional lives.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I agree with you there...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka even stayed on her diet even after she stopped being an idol because it was just a part of her routine by that point...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She said it would feel too strange if she didn't...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So being an idol was just simply what her life sort of was...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka's a lot tougher than any of us realize...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's why it never seemed like she was overdoing it or pushing herself too hard. I kind of feel bad for talking about it behind her back.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see, but you're not actually sure yourself...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's the thing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka back then was so good at what she did...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's like she just always knew what to do in order to keep going as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And she's still like that even now. I hate to say it, but she wouldn't be Haruka Kiritani otherwise...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But Shizuku knew Haruka a lot better than I did back then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There might be something that Shizuku knows that I don't know about when it comes to Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Than why don't you talk to Shizuku to see if she does know something?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that might be my best bet for now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: *Sigh*... It's great to finally have that off my chest.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for listening, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, there's no need for that. I was just worried about Shizuku and Haruka is all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Give Shizuku my regards, okay, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course! I'm not sure if I'll be of any help, but I'll try talking to her when I find the right time to...!

Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Line:
Alright, for today's practice, we'll...
Huh? Just you, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For now. Minori said she'll be late because of a committee meeting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Same situation as Shizuku then. She said she had to attend a committee meeting too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How about we just start with some stretches?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
I'm not sure I thanked you yet, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank me? For what?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For taking last Sunday off so that we could all go out shopping together. Shizuku told me that it was your idea.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've been meaning to tell you how much I appreciated your thought. Thank you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It was nothing, really.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, Shizuku seemed much more concerned than I was and this talk I had with her just sort of ended up with that idea.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I was able to have a fun day off because of that. I even made an important realization.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So again, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: *Sigh*... You're such a good kid.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That part of you really hasn't changed since back then. Of course, I mean it all in a good way...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, really. You've always been this idol who could focus on a goal and give it everything you have while you worked away at it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've always admired that part of you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So much so that I kept wondering why I couldn't do what you do...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I think you can, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hold on. Let me finish.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Your goal was to give hope to as many people as you could while being the best idol you could be, and you never stopped trying...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You tried so hard that it became a part of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It never occurred to me that I was trying so hard.

rows.Speaker: Airi
