rows.Line: Airi, we still have quite a bit of time, so why don't we go see what's going on with that stage?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, sure!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: First, let's get some drinks to stay hydrated. Then we can just sit back and enjoy the show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure!
One week after the Summer Festival
Diner

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mmm... This roasted tea parfait is so good! Don't knock it before you try it just because it's a diner, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree!
I'll try mine now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, the syrup on this warabimochi parfait goes so well with the sweet soybean powder that it came with.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? Hey, both of you, mind sharing a little since we have some extra plates?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, be my guest!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... That was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for tagging along with me, Ena, Shizuku! I'm glad we got to try so many Japanese-styled desserts!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm just glad I got to hang out with you two. That was a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Even though we bumped into each other during the festival, it sort of has been a while since we hung out together like this, huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Um, Ena?
About Mizuki... How have things been since, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'd like to know too...
You two looked like you were having quite a bit of fun during the festival.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not sure I can say there's been much progress...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry for not being able to help you out much, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm also sorry...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, you two have nothing to apologize for!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Like we discussed before, I know that this might take a very, very long time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And you've both already been a huge help just by listening to what's going on between me and Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you sure? In that case, I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We may not be out of the woods yet, but Mizuki has shown some signs of seemingly feeling better...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, really?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes. I think this other girl in our group said something and ended up having a positive effect...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That taught me that I can cheer Mizuki up by just talking about whatever's going on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Everything I did sort of felt futile at first, but now I know that's not actually the case anymore.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Yeah, the difference between knowing and not knowing that is pretty huge.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (As much as I was worried about Mizuki, I was getting concerned over how hard Ena had to try. I'm glad she's been able to make some progress.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the way, Ena, what are the other people in your group like?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, the others? Well, you already know me, the illustrator, and Mizuki, the video editor...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But we also have a songwriter and a lyricist.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, but the lyricist is also able to write her own songs from scratch too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I had no idea!
That's incredible!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, it really is...
But she's kind of a pain.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right out with it, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You just don't get it, Airi. She's an enormous pain to deal with!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Care to expand on that a little?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I just let my mouth run, huh? Maybe I shouldn't have asked that...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's okay, Ena. You don't have to answer if you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it's just kinda hard to describe... It's a pretty long story, so maybe next time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, that works too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, how about I talk about our songwriter instead?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Being able to make illustrations and videos is already very impressive, but I'm always amazed by people who can write their own songs.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah! Her name's K...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: K invited me, Mizuki and our lyricist to form a group called Nightcord at 25:00.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, so she's like the leader then!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sort of, but K doesn't really see it that way.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, K's unbelievably talented when it comes to songwriting. It's like she really knows how to touch your heart through music.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know what you mean! I've seen a few of your guys' videos, but they really do all have that effect.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi told me about one of your songs as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It was just a roller coaster of emotions, from feeling somewhat sad in the beginning to having a warm blanket wrapped around me in the end.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes! That's exactly what I'm talking about!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: K has this power to know what you're feeling or trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: When I was going through a huge art slump, she ended up composing something just for me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She must be such a nice person...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, she really is.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd like to meet this K sometime if I ever get a chance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to as well!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure, I hope I do get a chance to introduce you to her. Oh, there's this other girl too. She's a bit of a handful, but you might end up meeting her too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A bit of a handful? You have all this respect for K but not her lyricist?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because she's a pain to deal with.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll understand what I mean if you do ever talk to her. On top of that, she has some pretty serious baggage...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Baggage?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's not really giving me a clear picture.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you seem to enjoy talking about her, Ena. I'm sure she's a good person deep down.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What are you talking about?! I do not enjoy talking about her...!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (As much as I'm interested in her friends, we should introduce her to Minori and Haruka at some point as well.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That makes four per group... Wow, eight when you put us all together...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We've come a long way since having only each other to talk to...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm glad we both found some people we really care about. It'd be fun to just chat without a care in the world with them all.)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's take another look at the stream we did with the elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Normally, we'd be able to look at everybody's comments while we're live...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that wasn't really possible this time since we needed to focus on making it a special day for the students.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's very true. I tried to make sure our viewers could stay involved too, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: All of that included, let's see what we did well and what we didn't do so well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here we go.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: <Nooo... I'm so sorry...>

rows.Speaker: Boy's Voice
rows.Line:
<No, it's okay.
You did your best!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Aren't you supposed to be cheering them up?>
<Yeah, it's okay! lol>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, they were all saying, It's okay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha... I'm glad they enjoyed that, but I'm so embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see some snide remarks peppered in, but it certainly looks like they enjoyed what we did.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Ever since we did that show with Nanamin, everybody's viewing Minori in a completely different light.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: Me again?! Why's everybody coming after me?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, it's my team against Shizuku's team...)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<The way Shizuku runs, it's like she's an angel...>
<You can do it, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Haha! They're all going after Airi!>
<They love Airi so much! She's a bigger kid magnet than Shizuku!>
<The Wide World of Laughs was where I first saw Airi too.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She was more of a comedian than an idol on TV, you know?>
<She had to be making bank, right?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I guess most people still don't see me as a real idol...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But the past is the past! I just have to keep doing everything I can to establish myself as Airi Momoi of MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Especially for Shizuku's sake since she was there for me when I really needed help.)

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: <Heh heh heh! That won't be enough to catch me...! I still have plenty left in the tank!>

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: <Watch as I do some... Happy Side Steps!!>

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: <Oh wow! She's really doing Happy Side Steps!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I did that because I thought the kids would like it, but I didn't think about how everyone else would react...)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Yes!!>
<Whoa! We get to see this live!>
<Minori's way into this too! lol>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-Wah! L-Look at all the comments...!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<This is great! My sides...!>
<Yeah! Talk about showmanship!>
<This is why Airi's the best!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Did you see that last comment, Airi?!
One person said, You're making us all feel Happy! They're even praising your wonderful showmanship!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Calm down, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I missed that one about feeling Happy, but I think I managed to get a look at the other ones.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But there are still so many!
I can't keep up!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me neither. Maybe we should pause the video for a second and switch to the comment viewer.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That last wave of comments was mostly about Airi too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. They really enjoyed what you did, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, Haruka, stop...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry. Could you rewind a little?
I'd like to see that last comment again...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
One second...
Um... Here?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Airi, I'm a big fan of yours! We met at a meet and greet one time! I'm watching with my friend who also really loves you!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I still have that keychain I got during your show too! It's one of my most prized possessions!!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, that keychain on your bag...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Student A
rows.Line: Oh yeah! I bought it when I went to see one of your shows, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Student B
rows.Line:
We're both really big fans, Airi!
Look, we have matching colors too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Is that them...?!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know exactly how they feel.
All the stuff I bought during shows and events still mean so much to me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And they all become precious parts of these wonderful memories.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, did you see this person's comment...?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <The stuff they did on that show had to be brutal, but Airi just kept smiling and making us laugh. She really is the best.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This one too, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Airi must have nerves of steel!>
<With her, it's anything goes, and she always delivers.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Airi's definitely #1 for idols I respect most. I mean, she wrestled against a pro!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She isn't just another cute face!>
<Airi forever!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I had to stay in a hospital and miss school once, but you gave me the strength to recover and go back, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Airi's fans seem way more dedicated than regular idol fans.>
<You helped me get through entrance exams, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I still reached them, somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're such a wonderful person, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You gave all these people hope, courage, strength and the power to move forward.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm an idol! That's my job!
Lunch Break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, since it's so nice outside today, would you like to have lunch with me in the courtyard?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, sounds good.
Oh, hang on. Someone just sent me something...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, it's from Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She says that the principal of that elementary school sent her an email.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They also want to present us with a gift from the students but weren't sure where to send it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I knew we'd forgotten something... We don't have anything like that set up yet, do we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do you mean a place where our fans can send us their letters and such...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, I appreciate how everyone's been sending us stuff digitally...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But this seems like a good opportunity for us to get started on that. Why don't we all discuss this after school?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!
One week later

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, we're all here.
Let's open the package that the principal sent us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's not very big, but a lot heavier than it looks.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it is. What could be inside?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well, let's open it and find out.
Here goes nothing...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, isn't this the yearbook we made during the event...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it is! And there's one for each of us?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's great! We each get to keep one!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, and I'll let the principal know that we received this later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, look.
It's the group photo we took with all the students.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. They look so happy too!
I can't help but smile.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, there's something else. Four envelopes to go with each yearbook it looks like...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right. They have our names on them too. This looks like mine... Here's Shizuku's...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here's yours, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I wonder what's inside...
It feels sort of... Soft...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it does. Based on its size and how it feels, it could be something made of construction paper...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, let's open them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
There... What the...?!
These look like... Pink flower petals?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, mine were light blue.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess they made flowers in each of our colors to act as cushions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. So that's why it felt so soft!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and it's such a nice way to cap things off.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, there's a thank you card and some fan art by them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! They're in my envelope too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Thank you for visiting!> <Your show was really fun!> <We'll win at tag next time, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's great! They really crammed as much as they could onto these cards, huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Thank You Card
rows.Line: <Thank you, Happy Everyday! Thank you, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is it safe to say that our first solo gig was a success?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I believe so.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't help but go through all these messages.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
I can't wait to read the rest when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, quick suggestion. Mind if we move back the start of practice today by just a bit...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, you want to read what the students wrote, right? Plus, we have a whole yearbook to go through.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think it'd be better if we take the time now to get it out of the way. Then we'll be able to have them in our hearts while we practice. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, then it's settled!
And let's get cracking!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (A yearbook, fan art, flowers and a thank you card...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We really reached them. We gave them hope...)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She seemed so disappointed...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but I'm not sure there's anything we can do about that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't believe someone's willing to help us like this! Now, our event might just...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is this the right way to go?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By agreeing to have this person help us, we'd be making them “work” instead of having fun, no...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In other words, we'd be forcing our fans to face reality and see what goes on behind the scenes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want to do everything in my power to make sure our fans get to enjoy our events as fans.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. I get what you're trying to say, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Something about having our fans see the other side of the stage while we try to spread hope from that stage does seem a bit off.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The proposal we received really did look professional, so having a person like this helping us with our event could be pretty fun...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree... But I'm also a little worried about some of the things that you just said, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. It may not be a big one, but it's still an event. We have to take responsibility for what we do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, we have to do what our managers used to do for us, including booking a venue, setting a schedule and hiring a staff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. This is going to be our first event, so asking our fans to help us seems...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A bit much? We are sort of jumping straight into the deep end here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only that, we're freelance idols. We have to plan and prepare everything ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, which means...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have to keep streaming and doing schoolwork on top of planning for this event.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But if push comes to shove, we could cut back on streaming to give ourselves more time to prepare for our event.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? No, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Don't give us that.
It's written all over your face.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're worried about Minori, right...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. It's like all I did was shoot down all of her suggestions just now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look, there wasn't much you could do about that. Minori probably understands that we were having a serious discussion and have to look at this from different angles.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, wait, you said what you said because you wanted her to know what's most important about all this, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh...
Yeah, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Could it be that you're worried about how to interact with any fans that do end up helping us?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I am. I have a feeling that some situations are going to arise where we're going to have to speak to one another as employer and employee...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And if anything does end up happening during the event, we'd be forcing our fans to share in that burden by being our staff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm afraid that we'll be breaking their hearts instead of inspiring hope.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We should probably keep discussing this as a group moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But with more optimism if possible!
I have a feeling that we'll miss our mark if we keep thinking in terms of negatives.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you as always, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you thanking me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because you always seem to know exactly what to say in these situations. All I did was say how tough or difficult things will be...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that?
I don't think that's actually a bad thing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You always put your fans first, Haruka, and take everything you do as an idol seriously.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're willing to take a hard look at things and tell us exactly how you feel about them, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You may sound harsh at times, but I actually have an easy time accepting what you say.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure Minori feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, you're probably right.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Alright, the four of us are gonna have to keep discussing what to do about this event together.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Not being able to put on events in real life is gonna severely limit what we can do as a group...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Which means, we'll just have to come up with a way that lets us do events while spreading more and more hope!)
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, let's do a debrief for our event from the other day!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Have you all come up with things that you need to work on moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll overlap on a few things, so why don't we start with a quick rundown of what we have?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, let's hear it. What do you feel needs improving from here on out?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, we all said that scrambling to get things set up wasn't good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, why don't we start there?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I suppose we should think about what caused that all to happen, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, that seems pretty obvious.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We had a plan in terms of what to set up in which order, but didn't actually have a good idea of what the venue would be like.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That caused our staff to hesitate and even panic a little, so we need to make sure that doesn't happen again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, the walkways in the hall were much narrower than we expected. We lost quite a bit of time having to move equipment through it as a one-way path.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we may've been able to prevent that if we had a chance to see the hall beforehand...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it was booked solid until our event, so we couldn't...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We got to book this place because of a last-minute cancelation, so we sort of didn't have a choice but to do things on the fly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So moving forward, we'll need to see how wide or accessible the entrances, exits, walkways, breezeways and all that stuff at the venues we book are.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, next we have... Not having a different leader present to answer questions when Saito is either busy or absent.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We have so much to go over...)

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
That was really fun!
Seeing MORE MORE JUMP! live was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: I know, right? To be fair, I was pretty scared about what would happen after they started recruiting fans to work as staff... But everything went great!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
Yeah, I really want to see them again!
Maybe I'll join on as staff next time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They were all smiling at the end.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (A lot did happen, but we pulled together and succeeded. We need to take this experience and make sure our next event goes even better.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Besides, it wasn't all gloom and doom!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, that's everything we need to work on...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. So let's talk about what we did well!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! A lot happened, but it ended up being a big success!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, we're supposed to be talking specifics here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For example, it was pretty miraculous how none of our instructions ended up conflicting with each other...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Conflicting instructions?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm talking about how some of the equipment could've been taken to different places depending on who said what, like the stage as opposed to the back lot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think that has to do with how we exchanged information during our meeting prior to then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. I think we did a really good job planning out each step of the process and where we need to be careful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I was impressed by that as well.
That meeting we had really helped illustrate what we needed to do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought so too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: See what I mean? There's something else I think we achieved as well. Something pretty big.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh? What could that be?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We learned how to interact with the fans who decided to become our staff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not saying that we found the answer or anything like that, but I feel like we have a much better idea of what to do now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On a personal level, I think we found a place of understanding and really learned to trust each other.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Trust...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We're not friends or anything and they're sort of our employees, but we didn't have to be all that formal with one another.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We found a way to understand that we're after the same thing and that this event can only succeed if we work together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If having mutual respect for each other means that they don't care how hard we have to work because they believe we'll dazzle them at the end, I want us to go after it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! That'd be amazing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that also means we'll have to work even harder than before to actually achieve that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi's right. If we can develop that sort of relationship with them, they might just be able to keep seeing us as idols.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, so we'll just have to keep doing everything we can to foster that wonderful bond!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, let's keep doing our best, together!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I hereby open the inaugural meeting of our Secret Valentine's Day Alliance! Let's get started, you two!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So what are we gonna talk about today?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our topic today will be “What do you want to bake?”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's based on all the ideas you both told me about at school earlier, remember?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see...
Saki, you're wondering how to actually surprise everyone, while Emu doesn't know how to make her gifts.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I wanna make some shiny star cookies, chocolate robots and a cake that looks like a show stage!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So today, I'm hoping that we can use that as a springboard to really figure out what we want to make or bake for Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which leads me to my next question. Do you two have anything specific in mind already?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, Valentine's Day equals chocolates or something chocolatey, right...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But no, I still don't really have a good idea of what to give everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me neither, but I know that I want to make a cake that'll make Tsukasa and the others go, “Wow!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I also wanna decorate it with lots of other delicious sweets, like chocolates, cookies and macarons!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's a great idea. Then it'd be like a goodie bag of treats!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that is pretty good!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It'll definitely be enough to surprise everyone, but I still think we can do a little more.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Also, Saki seems to be better at coming up with an overall theme for surprises like this.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, but...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Neither of them seems to have much experience baking sweets, so on top of me helping them out, our base needs to be something we can all make.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Emu even mentioned something about turning a cake or something into a show stage.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Then, let's go with...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, you two, I've got an idea!
Mind listening up for a second?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! What sort of idea?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You two seem to have plenty of ideas for decorations and what you want to do with them, but what if we all had the same base for them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, like a matching trio!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! It also means we'd have Airi there to help us every step of the way!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. Not only will it make this whole process easier, but it'll also be more of a hands-on learning experience!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And in the event that one of us makes a mistake, we'd still be able to share ingredients with each other as insurance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Y-You're even prepared for that...?!
What if Airi's really a baking goddess in disguise...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! That also means she's our goddess!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Settle down, you two.
I'd really rather not be put on a pedestal like that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Regardless, I was thinking that we could each bake a chocolate cake to serve as a base.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that'd be perfect for Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, but why chocolate cakes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: First, a cake would make what Emu wants to do possible since she'd be able to decorate it pretty freely.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Second, we can bounce decoration ideas off of each other.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So it's okay that you're still undecided, Saki, since this should at least help you get started.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That makes so much sense!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, this is gonna be the most important part.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'll be up to you two to decide how you want to decorate your cakes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh... R-Right...!
What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm gonna decorate my stage with lots and lots of show stuff☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like Emu's all set with her “show stage” cake theme.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This might be a good time for you to also choose a theme, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A theme...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. What sort of theme do you think will make your friends the happiest?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What would make Ichi and the girls the happiest...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Oh, a show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We started playing at live houses recently, so they'll probably really love it if I also made my cake look like a show stage!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, a show's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, now that we all have a theme in mind, we can start working out the details!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's take everything we discussed today to figure out specific plans for each of our cakes!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We learned so much about baking cakes and sweets in just one day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I always thought cakes had to be round or square. I never knew that you could make them look like hearts or stars!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me neither! I always thought that only patisseries could make those!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. This rabbit hole goes pretty deep. I recommend looking at some baking sites online for reference.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I will! And thank you so much for doing all this for us today, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Our cakes are gonna be so amazingly wonderhoy because of you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm just glad I could help both of you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you bring up a good point. Let's make the best chocolate cakes we can and give everyone a Valentine's Day gift that they'll never forget!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Emu & Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!
Weekend after Valentine's Day
Diner

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <They should be here pretty soon, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, they just messaged me saying that they're at the station and making their way over.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We were able to message each other about how our surprises went, but haven't actually had a chance yet to talk about it in person.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. That means they're also probably really excited about meeting you today♪>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I sure hope so.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I'll leave my phone on top of the table to make sure you can listen in too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Thanks, Airi♪>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
After all, you're also a valued member of the Secret Valentine's Day Alliance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'm sure you want to hear how their surprises went as well, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Hello! We're here♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Oh, that must be them!
Time to hide, but I'll be listening.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry about the wait, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you two came together?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We ran into each other at the entrance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe☆ But not literally this time♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, have a seat, you two!
Let's order some stuff and start celebrating!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright...
Here's to a successful Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Emu & Saki
rows.Line: Cheers!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much again for everything, Airi! My surprise went over really, really, really well because of you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Most of all, my friends couldn't believe that I made cookies of each of them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, those cookies!
The ones you worked really hard on, and made over and over again?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I'm really glad that I didn't give up on them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho even thought that I had them specially made. You should've seen the look on her face when I told her that I made them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? You surprised cool and calm Shiho that much? Sounds like your surprise was a roaring success!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
How about you, Emu?
Did everyone feel wonderhoy after you unveiled your surprise?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe☆ Not just wonderhoy...
Super duper funtastically wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Super duper funtastically?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! My surprise went so well that I thought I was dreaming!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haha! That means they really must've loved it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They really did! And it's all thanks to you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How did your surprise go, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The cake was a hit, but everyone loved the marzipan dolls I made of them most of all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Those dolls you made were sooo cute!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?! I couldn't believe how detailed their costumes and faces were! They all looked professionally made...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can teach you two how to make them sometime if you want.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Y-You will...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! It's like we can do anything as long as we have Airi around!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, it's not going to be a bed of roses.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait! I just remembered how Minori said that Airi's a really tough teacher!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But if it means being able to make stuff like that on my own, then please teach me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too! I wanna learn how!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's what I like to hear. Seek me out when you feel you're ready.

rows.Speaker: Emu, Saki & Airi
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Still, are you sure about this?
I originally got to know you as a fan so...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see. Sure, we started out as an idol meeting one of her fans...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But now I feel like things have changed a little.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, we go to the same school and you're my juniors, so feel free to ask me for help whenever!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On top of all that, we're all still members of the Secret Valentine's Day Alliance, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We swore to protect a secret together, Saki, Emu, so I hope we get to hang out more like this as comrades!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too...!
Again, Airi, thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, Airi, you're really the best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, you two!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Rin, the coast is clear.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry about that.
You didn't really get a chance to do anything other than listen, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <No, that's okay! I had plenty of fun just hearing how their surprises went♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Getting to see you girls bake was also really great, so let me know if you need any help again♪>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
And don't forget to ask for help if you ever need it, alright?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay♪>
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, finally...!
Homework's all done!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now I can work on the design for my outfit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
An outfit for all of us...
For MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, I still want to go with something that screams, “I'm an idol!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
For starters...
A skirt that blooms open as we dance is a must.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What else...?
Oh, some lace and ribbons to bring out its cuteness!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When I was still in QT...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, where'd I put that notebook with all of the outfits I wore back then...? Oh, here it is!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I should also look up what other idols wear for reference...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, that about does it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I sort of just drew whatever came to mind...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But it doesn't look original.
Someone's gonna say, “I've seen that before somewhere.”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I guess these are just the side effects of trying to design something that screams, “I'm an idol!”)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It might be better for me to pick a more concrete theme or set of motifs if I want it to look more original.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hmm...
What kind of theme would suit us best...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What kind of motifs...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's it. Clovers...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They symbolize “hope”, “promise” and “love”...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I remember telling Shizuku and the others about this before too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
“To become idols who can spread hope to others.”
“To promise never again to forget that feeling.”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, “To show our idol-loving fans just how much we care about them.”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's what I think the three leaves on these clovers represent.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! That's so beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, it is. We'll need to work hard to achieve all of the things you just listed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we will.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, those outfits were born out of our thoughts and feelings.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hope, promise and love...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Come to think of it...
Clovers kinda look like hearts too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hearts...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! This might just work...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Especially since hearts are what idols are after!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Not only that, I'm...
Lovely! Fairy! Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, I'll use hearts as a motif for my design!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. More than that. It's gonna be all about hearts!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know. What if I made it so the skirt sort of turns into a heart as we're dancing?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, it can throw a big heart on the back too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? But it might make more sense if it were front and center on the bust.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's getting pretty late. It might be better to just think about where I'm going with this and pick up where I left off tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Forget it! I'm just gonna draw everything that comes to mind instead of worrying over if it's right or not!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't care if I have to work into the night. A part of me is telling me that I won't get a chance like this again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's start with a big heart on the back!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It should look super cute whenever we turn around during a dance routine. Also...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: F-Finished...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For now, I've managed to cram everything that came to mind into this design!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Mhm...
*Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa! It's already past two?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This should be more than enough for tonight.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good night...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, you guys!
We're gonna see how our outfits are coming along today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay! I can't wait to see how they're looking!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope the design I sent wasn't too confusing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? I thought it was pretty easy to follow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The ones in charge of putting them together sent us a reply last night, so let's go over each point while keeping your concerns in mind, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's start with our lead dressmaker...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here we are... <Hello, everyone from MORE MORE JUMP!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I'll be handling Airi's outfit and I'm beyond ecstatic about being given this opportunity!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I'm only able to provide a sample of what's to come right now, but I honestly can't stop grinning knowing that Airi's going to be wearing this outfit.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <And thank you for sending over such a well-annotated design. It was very easy to follow.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I'll be putting everything I have into this to make sure you're satisfied with the finished product.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds like you have nothing to worry about, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm glad they understood everything.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Especially since you took the time to redraw it a few times to make sure they'd see what you were thinking.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, being able to work on your favorite idol's outfit must be a huge source of motivation.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we have Minori to thank for that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's see what the others said!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew. That should be all of them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Looks like they're all progressing nicely.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And they're gonna send over their samples once they're done, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We'll need to see for ourselves whether or not they actually fit or match our designs.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After we've checked everything, we'll start having them sew on the decorations and other accessories.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which by no means will be easy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're not exactly professional designers, so I have a feeling that we'll have to learn some things for the first time as we go.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. We should make it clear that they're always free to ask us for help or suggestions.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I forgot to read the postscript for that last email.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's go through it now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:

rows.Line: But the theme was “happiness”... What do you think the other winning entries are gonna be like?

rows.Line: Oh, Airi, why don't we make some predictions on our way over?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, that sounds fun!
Let's do that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That exhibit was better than I expected!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it was. The sheer number of photos on display was so astounding too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Some other people went with wedding scenes, like Ms. Kawasaki, but I was surprised by how many pictures of animals there were.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. The one with the big dog lovingly watching over that little newborn really left an impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The way it gazed at that baby was so gentle too. It was just so heartwarming.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Those pictures capture many different kinds of “happiness”, but I've gotta say, the ones of families topped them all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, everyone in those photos looked like they couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of pictures of families, one really stuck out to me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, which one?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you remember, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The one where the dad has his two kids sat on his lap while they all cheer and wave glow sticks as they watch a DVD of an idol concert together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And I really loved the title.
“Calling All Fans!!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I remember!
The three of them had such adorable smiles on their faces!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, they did. Not only that, their living room was covered wall to wall with idol merch.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They must be serious fans since I noticed that they had some limited edition stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They did? I saw that they had quite an assortment of merchandise, but I didn't realize some of those things were limited edition.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Heh heh. There's a reason I research idols, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, I couldn't help but take a closer look since it really made me happy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, they're following idols as a family. Isn't that great?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just think about it. That means we could also be making an entire family smile like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're right! That'd make me so happy if we have!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And when those kids are big enough, they might even get to go see some shows together!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds so wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, do you think it was the mother who took this photo?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I've gotta think it was someone from that family.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You really can't capture these sorts of happy and heartwarming moments unless you're a part of that family, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. When I saw that photo, the image of the person taking it having just a big smile on their face popped into my head.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We really got to see some incredible works today. I couldn't be more satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me neither. That exhibit really reminded us that happiness comes in all shapes and sizes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. And as idols who want to spread hope, we have to keep doing our best to get others to feel what we did today!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right! The four of us, together!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That should be enough practice for today. Make sure to stretch later, okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm exhausted! And so hungry...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. How about we stop by somewhere on our way back?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I'm up for that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Just don't eat too much.
Also, I'd like to head home now to think of ideas for our training camp.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Airi...
Are you sure you don't want us to help?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'll be fine.
I'm right in the middle of refining things down.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I'm so excited for our training camp! I can't wait to hear about what we're gonna do!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, Airi, have you finalized anything yet?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well, yes and no...
Either way, you'll just have to wait until then to find out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? We have to wait until the day of? Not until you've made a decision?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is that because we'll react more genuinely during our stream...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Precisely!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
One more thing.
There's something that I want you to start thinking about, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka, Shizuku and I all have a lot of experience being on TV and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As such, we know that things don't always go according to the script and have learned how to handle unforeseen situations.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, Minori, you don't have much experience with that, so to you, it's easier said than done, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right...
I probably wouldn't know what to do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, for this training camp, I want you to arrive having not practiced or rehearsed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Simultaneously, I simply want you to expect the unexpected.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
U-Understood!
But am I really gonna be okay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I think so.
You'll need to know how to handle those sorts of situations for our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. Not only that, it's our own stream, so you probably don't need to worry about causing any trouble.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
My thoughts exactly.
We don't get many opportunities like this, so let's make the most of it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, now that I've finished doing my homework, I can get back to working on stuff for our training camp.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (In terms of segments, these should do nicely.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And I'm so glad that I asked MEIKO for some advice. They've become really fun as a result.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, our stream this time around's gonna be pretty long... We'll need to do what we can to keep our viewers interested throughout.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I also need to figure out where we're actually gonna go and what sort of equipment we'll be using.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nanamin's agency took care of that for our Christmas event, but this time, we have to take care of all of that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I could conceivably handle that, but it might be nice to have an advisor of sorts...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Someone with a lot of experience working on variety shows, shooting on location and taking care of all the right paperwork...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know...! I can ask the scriptwriter I used to work a lot with! The one from The Wide World of Laughs!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I remember hearing that they decided to settle down and work for a regional TV station.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If I can get them to lend me a hand...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, here goes nothing!
The next day

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I got a reply to that email I sent yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... <Momoi, it's been so long. About the thing you asked me about...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <If it's alright with you, I'd like to help out>...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
Now I can hear what a professional thinks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, they even made sure to quote me for their consultation.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This must mean they're really looking at what we're doing as professionals.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Regardless of the fact that we're freelancers...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, we're talking about a person that said, “It doesn't matter if someone's a rookie idol or a comedian who's yet to find fame. They're all professionals in my mind if they appear on TV.”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That sort of came with the condition that you provide good reactions or can say something interesting... But it was always worth putting in the effort.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That really takes me back...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Looking back, that person always came up with ideas that were just tough enough for me to wonder whether or not I could handle them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And they didn't have to make us fail on purpose or come up with a surprise. They were designed in a way that something interesting would always happen.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In terms of what we'll be doing, renting out a public pool and trying to cross a floating obstacle course was kinda similar...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, I didn't get to try all of the things they came up with, so I could use those for reference.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (When I was still appearing on variety shows, I was told a lot of not-so-nice things and felt really awful at times...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I also got to meet a lot of great people and get to work with them again like this.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It just goes to show that it's important to enjoy the process.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I should start by sending them a reply!
Beach

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, everyone!
We still have plenty of things planned for you to enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. And tonight, we'll be doing...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: “MORE MORE JUMP! Before Bedtime”.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We all worked super hard today, so now, we'll be having a nice, little chat.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's so serene. I can hear the waves very clearly. And the sea breeze feels lovely...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, the stars look really pretty too...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. We should definitely soak in as much of the scenery as we can since we're down by the sea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now, as for our talking points...
Minori, if you will.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You got it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We've been receiving lots and lots of questions, so for this edition of “Tell Us! MORE MORE JUMP!” we'll be answering them as we go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In particular, a ton of you asked...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “Which personal care products do you all use?”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Quite a few of our fans are girls, so that may explain why we received so many questions regarding this and fashion.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but fashion will sadly have to wait until another time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For now, we'll be discussing our favorite personal care products while actually putting them to use.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Woohoo! I've been waiting for this!>
<Does this mean I can look like Haruka if I use what she does?>
<Tell me more! How do idols take care of themselves?!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's start with Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be introducing the treatment oil I use for my hair.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna know more about how you take care of your hair! I mean, yours always looks so gorgeous, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Would you all like to try using it?
It has this wonderful fragrance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Oh wow... It smells sweet, like vanilla.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A few of my modeling friends introduced it to me. Apparently, it's used in quite a few hair salons.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It is a bit more expensive than what you normally see in stores, but this oil is incredible at making your hair really shine. And it feels so wonderful after using it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Y-You're right...!
My hair feels so light! It feels so smooth on my fingers!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's also perfect for winter as it prevents static from building up. I hope you all get a chance to try using it sometime.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be introducing our next product.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My choice is this body lotion.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<What?! I've seen that at the pharmacy!>
<I've been using that too!!>
<Really? It's so common.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. A fairly well-known pharmacy chain carries this, so I'm sure some of you have seen this before.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: On top of being a great moisturizer, this lotion possesses certain properties that help protect your skin against irritation.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That, coupled with its relatively low cost per volume means you can use lots of it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I started using it after Haruka recommended it to me. Not only does it not feel wet and sticky, it makes your skin really smooth and soft.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, Minori, you use it too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. Incidentally, the hand lotion I want to introduce is made by the same company!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see. That's the perfect segue, so take it away.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That just leaves me!
I brought along my beloved muscle roller!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whenever I had to move around a lot or do something athletic for a variety show, I'd use this to loosen up my muscles afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Especially the soles of my feet! This thing really does wonders!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it's made of wood, but it also feels nice in my hands. Mind if I tried using it, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, go for it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that does feel nice...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It does?! I usually massage myself down, but I don't think I've ever used anything like that before!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, wanna have Haruka use it on you?
I'm guessing she's pretty good at this kind of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Would that be alright, Minori?
If so, come here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
H-Haruka massaging me...? Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Someone's happy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, Minori, I'm gonna try using it on your feet. Just try to relax for me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, here it goes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Ow-wow-wow-wow-wow!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry about that.
Was that too strong? I sort of went with how I usually massage myself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm okay...
You startled me a little is all... Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you seemed to enjoy it when you were massaging your own feet, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you mind trying it on me next?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. I'll go a little easier this time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. That kind of tickles...
It's okay if you go a little harder.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Are you sure? Then... Is this good?
It's about as hard as I went for Minori just now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that feels wonderful...
This is perfect.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Were you hamming it up just now, Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Ahh, that was so nice...
Why don't you go next, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me? Yeah, sure. Since we're at it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: O-Owwwwww!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: H-H-Haruka! S-Stop...!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? I went pretty easy there just now. Was that too much for you, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, could this mean that Minori and Airi's bodies are suffering from something...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. They say that the place where it hurts is linked to another part of your body.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And that seemed to be where the big toe joins her foot, as well as the arch... Which means there's possibly something wrong with your neck or organs.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... Is it because I sat at my desk for a really long time while planning for our training camp?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That has to be it!
You need the most TLC out of all of us, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. I'm sure you'll feel a little better after I massage that part more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: M-Minori, what have you done...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't worry. I'll go a little easier than before, so let me just start from here and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: N-No, wait! I'm glad that you want to help, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A-Aaahhhhh...!!
One month before the solo show
Rental Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, about today's meeting...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saito gave me the final layout for the venue the other day, so I'd like to have a discussion about that.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here, we can use this space.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay. Thanks, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So... What's changed?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Where the equipment's going to be placed on the right and lefthand sides of the stage. It looks like they're going to be placed more towards the edges.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that means we'll be able to use almost all of the stage!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And it'll make it easier for us to see everyone sitting in those sections.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, the equipment's pretty big too. I like the idea of moving them since they'd sorta dominate the show if you're sitting right next to them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, going forward with this means we're gonna need to rethink how we perform certain songs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, why?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that's right... Our second song...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Our second song? Um... Oh, are you talking about the interlude...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? I still don't get it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's okay, Minori.
Lemme explain how things are gonna go when we're actually on stage.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For our first song, we're gonna walk around as much of the stage as we can to get a good look at all of our fans' faces.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do you remember where you're supposed to stand at the end, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Haruka and I are stage left, and you and Shizuku are stage right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Correct. We'll stay in those positions and sing our second song until its interlude. Then, we'll walk out on stage to look at our fans, and meet back in the middle... Well, that was the plan...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And there lies the problem.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? So, this is the part you were talking about just now? About changing where the equipment is gonna be placed and how it'll affect the show?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, changing where they're placed will allow us to use more of the stage. You follow me there, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because we'll get to use more of the stage, we'll have to physically travel greater distances.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right, so...!
Hm? Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I vaguely remember us talking a while back about trying to travel as much as we possibly could for the second song's interlude...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, we did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As a result of these changes, we can't move as much as we initially planned for this part anymore because otherwise we won't make it in time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, what?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wait! What if we ran instead of walking?! Wouldn't that solve the problem?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but it may end up taking away from the dance we'll be doing following the interlude.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Especially since our original goal was to conserve our energy, build up some anticipation and stun the audience by performing a fun and dynamic dance routine for them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Y-You're right...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is one of the parts we really focused on and practiced a lot for...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's no guarantee that what we want to show is what our fans actually want to see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Given those options, I'll always prioritize the enjoyment of our fans over our own objectives.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Then...
Do we need to change the dance routine after the interlude?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's the easiest solution...
But we need to keep the energy going for the second half of our show, so not changing it would be best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. So, why don't we try thinking about what else we can do?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Like... Changing the way we move during the interlude, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And seeing exactly how much more space we'll have based on where the equipment is going to be moved.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, we'll be able to measure how much more time we'll need to travel that extra distance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I know!
What if we did this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you wanna extend the interlude?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm thinking that we can extend the song by looping a part of the interlude. That should give us the time we need to move around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll need to test this to make sure it'll work, but it should be okay since it's not that big a change. Plus, it shouldn't affect the other parts of our show much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and if this works, our dance routine should go just as we initially planned.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's actually pretty common to extend the interlude for a song to give everyone more time to engage with their fans during shows...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And the fans usually end up enjoying these moments.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then it's settled! I'll ask Saito right away to see if this idea will work.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, lemme jot that down...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What are you writing, Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm writing down everything I learned during today's meeting!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We made these sorts of adjustments to the performance we did for the fan event, but I always seem to learn something new whenever we go through this process.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, that's very studious of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And it's a good idea too since sudden changes can lead to causing a lot of people a lot of trouble...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm sure our show will go well after holding discussions like this together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And if it means putting smiles on all of our fans' faces, then we gotta do everything we can!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We promise to cheer for you like there's no tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I know you're nervous, Minori, but please try to enjoy your very first solo show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right!
I really appreciate it, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm gonna do the best I can!
I really wanna make the most of my first solo show since I only get one chance to perform in it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I suppose it's only natural to feel nervous before your first solo show...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. But I think what KAITO and the others said helped her with that a little...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, more than a little.

rows.Speaker: Kohane

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe, thanks.
I'll make sure to thank Akito the next time I see him.

rows.Line:
Alright, now it's time to take a photo. Everyone gather in front of the cake♪
Ready, Kohane?

rows.Line:
Yeah! Now to set the timer, and...
Okay everyone, we've got ten seconds!

rows.Line: (I got to celebrate with my fans, and now my friends are doing all this for me.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Today really is the best!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Momoi. I hope you and Ena continue to be good friends. Of course, don't feel like you need to go out of your way for her though.

rows.Line: Hey, what's that all about? You make it sound like I'm a burden to her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The only person you're burdening here is your li'l bro.
Thanks for delivering the card♪

rows.Line: Since we spent all night editing, our faces looked terrible, so we couldn't possibly present it to her in person...

rows.Speaker: Ena

rows.Line: Airi, I'll tell you all about how we made the animated short next time we meet up! Again, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Airi. I'm so glad you liked the cake and video surprises!
