rows.Line: We managed to get quite a bit of cake decoration practice in by using small figurines and plastic fruit! I'm glad it all paid off.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh yeah, the marzipan figurines turned out well. I was a bit concerned when I heard we were going to leave those in the hands of Saki and Otori...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh, some of Airi's skill rubbed off on us! I mean, she taught us how to make faces, so all that was left was to keep trying until they were 100% perfect!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's what Happy Everyday said on TV♪
So we both gave it our all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Airi, we'll be your fans forever and ever and eeever! We're right behind you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Airi! Seeing you smile all day made me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was glad to see all our livestream fans and everyone at the party having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everybody loves you, Airi. They must have been happy to be able to celebrate so much today. I sure was!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, that's right.
Happy birthday, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was really touched by everyone's birthday wishes and words of support.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It made me realize that every message I got was coming from somebody I gave hope.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I promise to keep spreading hope as Airi Momoi of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You right there!
Watch out 'cause I'm coming your way!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just messing around.
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, let's have a look at tomorrow's schedule... We have that meeting in the morning and will head to school in the afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka and Minori already know that we won't make our morning practice...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've made up my mind...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I gave her a lot to think about, but I'm glad she arrived on an answer that she's happy with...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Especially since she made me realize something really important...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, hehe. Right on time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Thanks for setting aside some time so we can chat, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's all good. We haven't seen each other at all recently, so I was really happy when you said you wanted to talk.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Really? Great!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Still, you guys really have been busy lately. I'm sure you're handling things fine... But don't push yourself too hard, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, I appreciate it.
But as an idol, my physical condition is one of my biggest assets, so I'm making sure to take good care of it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, Ena, I'm more concerned about you. Are you still a total night owl?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Huh? Me? I'm completely fine!
I mean, I've always been a night owl.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh yeah...
Did you hear about the new cafe that opened up by the station?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A new cafe? What's it supposed to be like?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Half of it's a cafe, but the other half's supposed to be an antiques shop.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Everything in the cafe is also apparently for sale. If you like the decor or the tableware they use, you can just buy the exact same ones on the spot.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really...?! This cafe's starting to sound pretty fun.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I know, right? On top of all that, their signature menu item is this tea and chiffon cake set that's decorated in a really cute way. I bet it'll get a ton of buzz online.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Wanna go together sometime?
Maybe this week...? No, that's probably too short notice, huh...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah... I have work all this week and next...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay. Yeah, that's understandable.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then, how about next month?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well... The weekends are gonna be tough.
I might be able to go in the evening during the week...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you have school then, right, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah... To be fair, the cafe's new and getting a ton of business, so I doubt it's gonna fold anytime soon.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: True. I'll let you know when I'm free.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay! Looking forward to it!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Ena never changes...
She always lets me know about these new places and invites me to go check them out...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I mean, there was one point when I was so busy that we didn't see each other for a month or so.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Of course, Ena was going through some tough stuff right around that time too...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But she still came over to talk so happily when she saw me at school...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Seeing her smile made any feeling of awkwardness about our reunion go away...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Ena's honest with her feelings. She doesn't hold anything back, in a good way...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That must be why we've been able to stay friends this whole time.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Um, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hm?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Remember that time during junior high when we didn't see each other for like a month because we both had so much going on?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I remember...
What about it?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So...
How do I put this...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wanna thank you for coming to talk to me like nothing had changed after not seeing each other for so long...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Your smile made me feel so much better that time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Huh? R-Really?
Why...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why...? Because it's pretty normal to not be sure how to interact with someone after not seeing them for so long, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I guess so...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Talk about a blast from the past...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I remember watching TV every single day to make sure I caught all the shows you were on, Airi...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And I went back to rewatch recordings of them on the days you weren't scheduled to appear...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I remember you sending me feedback on occasion regarding what you saw, so I had a feeling that you were a pretty avid viewer. Still...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hehe. Because of that, I got to meet you every day. Your smile would always help me forget about what was on my mind for a little while.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Which is probably why talking to you after being away for so long didn't feel awkward at all. It's like you were never gone.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For the longest time, Ena, I kept beating myself up about not being there for you when you were going through so much pain...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, don't say that...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You've always been there to cheer me up. Always. You're a big reason why I'm still doing art.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, Airi, thank you for what you did that time...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
H-Hey, no fair...!
What's with the sob story all of a sudden?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What?! You started it!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I didn't have a choice because there's something I need to tell you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Tell me...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ena, thanks for being my friend!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Is that all?
Of course I'm your friend.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She made it possible for us to pick up where we left off like nothing happened...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really, I can't thank you enough.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And about that cafe.
I promise to let you know when there's a gap in my schedule!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay. I'll invite you again if I find anywhere else that looks delicious or interesting, so keep your schedule open!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you got it!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Line: (We're all coming along nicely with that dance routine, so it might be time for us to start practicing singing while we dance.)

rows.Line: Oh, Ayumi! Morning!

rows.Line: Did your morning practice just finish?

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Sure! Hmm, well...

rows.Line: The contents of your bag definitely stood out to me the most, Airi.

rows.Line: Your pink pencil case and the pouch with kittens all over it really made it obvious that it was your bag!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: The heart-shaped keychain you had on that pouch was also really cute. And so sparkly!

rows.Line: Oh, that? I got it at one of the shops on Main Street after falling in love with it at first sight!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
What was that shop called?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Umm... I wanna say it had “jewelry” in its name, or something like it...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about Jeweller TOY BOX?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that's it! You know about it too, Ayumi?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Yup! I went one time after a friend tipped me off to it.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Do you know why they chose that name? It's a really great reason!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, I don't!
Tell me!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Hehe. They wanted their shop to be “A toy box filled with shiny gems just for you”!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really?! Yeah, it definitely works with their theme!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Right? They had so much nice stuff too.
It'd be great if we could go together sometime, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Wait, no... I'm sorry!
I couldn't help myself... Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, Ayumi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm all booked up this month, so I won't be able to anytime soon...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I also really, really wanna go check it out with you, Ayumi.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, hang on!
If we're going after school, I might actually be able to next week!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're taking a day off from practice to give ourselves time to recover. I also don't have work that day, so I think we can go.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Really?! I'd be totally okay with us just stopping by after school since it's not a very big shop.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Are you sure? It's supposed to be your day off, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course. I'll let you know once I've had a chance to take another look at our schedule.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to going with you, Ayumi!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Yeah... Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Airi!
I can't wait either! This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh no...! Homeroom's about to start.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Yeah, we gotta get to our classrooms!
I'll be waiting to hear back from you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure thing! I'll try to message you as soon as I can!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We made plans to hang out together. Just like old times...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Well, things aren't completely the same as they were back then...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But we still clearly want to talk and hang out with each other. That hasn't changed at all.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I need to keep treasuring that connection.)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Line: “The bonds you've forged with your friends won't easily break.”

rows.Line: I want to believe that too!

rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
Yeah.

rows.Line: We can start accepting those offers we initially couldn't.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Thank you, Minori.
I really appreciate how seriously you've been taking this matter.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, while we're on the subject...
I tried coming up with a schedule to help myself imagine being in the credit-based course...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Take a look!
If Haruka and I are both credit-based, we'll be free during these hours.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which means that one offer we thought we'd have to turn down would actually be—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ...is about it. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, that was very easy to understand.
Thank you for the wonderful explanation, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All this probably needs is a few minor fixes, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's put together better than I was expecting! Way to go, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... I used the ones you and Haruka made in the past as reference, Airi!

rows.Line: So, while we're at it, can you tell me what needs fixing so I know for the future?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure. Haruka, mind starting us off?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have a feeling that you're going to say the same, Airi, but these transit times did catch my eye...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. It's not a huge problem or anything, but it is a little concerning.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, okay! Lemme take some notes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, I will as well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, your schedule does give us some extra time whenever we move between places...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we may need to give ourselves a little more since we'll probably be riding taxis more often.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, taxis?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We'll be getting more TV exposure, right?
Using public transit's gonna become a bit tricky as the chances of people recognizing us goes up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right! I didn't think of that since we've never had any issues before!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One person may be no big deal, but the four of us together is probably gonna stand out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, when it comes to public transit...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You don't have to plan quite as strictly in the city since we always have multiple options to choose from, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! If we go to the countryside or something...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. Trains don't run as often, and there might not even be any taxis around until you call one in.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even in other cities, it's more than possible to get lost when you're somewhere unfamiliar.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, it's important for us to really do our research when we go outside the city.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, that makes sense!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are there any other points of concern that you can think of?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess, food...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, absolutely!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Food...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! It's always good to scout out restaurants and stuff around meeting locations.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Under the right circumstances, you can ask directors, producers or other staff to go grab a bite with you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is really important. It's one of the few situations where you can casually get to know each other, and even hear about industry trends and all kinds of other info.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Plus, it's just nice to know what's available around where we're going.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If we're in a hurry, it's good to know where the convenience stores are or what places do takeout. And diners and whatnot for when we have a little time on our hands.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, that does end up being really important. Worst case scenario, you might go a whole day without eating...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... That sounds awful...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That unfortunately happened to me one time. I was so embarrassed when my microphone picked up my stomach rumbling.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Most shoots are fully catered, but during planning meetings they usually only serve some snacks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Having a mic pick up your stomach growling's embarrassing, but so is chowing down on whatever's available...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait a second... Are you talking about me before our iHaz shoot...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, that was understandable.
Eating helps some people relax when they're nervous.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, what I'm trying to say is that it's important to be extra careful!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Trying to figure everything out on your own isn't exactly realistic, so it's always good to check with others, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. In fact, we could take this opportunity to assign ourselves to certain tasks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Like... Minori, you research our transit options.
I'll start looking for delicious places to eat!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're not just after the right to have your pick of restaurants, are you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Maybe, maybe not.

rows.Line:
You totally are!
No fair, Airi!

rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Line:
I had a feeling it was you!
Hi!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I am! Were you out shopping just now?

rows.Line: Yeah, I just went to buy a ring light for our streams.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Haruka even said how she's switching back to the credit-based course, so I'm even more excited about what MORE MORE JUMP! has in store for us!

rows.Line: (So Haruka already told her...)

rows.Line: (She's an idol through and through, so there's no reason for me to doubt her commitment...)

rows.Line: (But how do her friends feel...?)

rows.Line: Were you surprised when she told you about that?

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I know she's a really inspiring idol who can spread hope to lots and lots more people♪

rows.Line: So, as her friend, I wanna keep giving her all the support I can!

rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Thanks! MORE MORE JUMP! is gonna become an idol group that makes everyone's day brighter just from hearing our name!

rows.Line: Whoa! That's so awesome!

rows.Line: But we're not gonna let you hog all the glory!

rows.Line: We're gonna sign with a label, post lots of songs to our channel and play shows everywhere we can!

rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Line: Hehe... Then we might even get a chance to play on TV together someday♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:

rows.Line: Doesn't that apply to any tourist destination?

rows.Line:
Oh, also.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Do you have a general idea already?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, one option is to go see shrines and temples, while the other is to participate in hands-on activities.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, like the shrine with lots of red gates all in a row! I've seen so many pictures of that!

rows.Speaker: Airi

rows.Line: I looked it up and apparently, there are shops where you can make mutsuhashi and candy sculptures.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When did you look that up, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In secret, while the teacher was talking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On the other hand, none of that matters if the activities are traditional crafts...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, making your own mutsuhashi does sound like fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, does that involve picking a filling and putting it in the casing?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, better...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You get to make everything, even the casing, from complete scratch! Not only that, you can even choose a filling from matcha and chestnut on top of the normal red bean paste!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Wow!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Making them from scratch does sound like fun. That feels like a worthwhile activity.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right?! Actually, I kinda wanna do it on my own time regardless of whether or not it's part of the school trip activities.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I haven't been able to get it out of my head. I mean, you even get to steam them yourself...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
W-Wait, huh...?
Why are you all grinning like that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's nice to see that you're looking forward to this trip is all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Especially since you've been saying how you'll put work first if we get a request.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So I was under the impression that you weren't really looking forward to it that much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: N-No, I have been...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, I'm a high school girl too! I also want to have some fun experiences while I'm still a student...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So...!
Wipe those angelic grins off your faces!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You in particular, Minori! It feels weird when you act all motherly towards me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! I was just really glad to hear that you're looking forward to going on this trip!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, stop it stop it stop it! That's what I'm talking about! Alright, you've left me no choice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?! Hahaha...!
Airi, stop! That tickles...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A-Anyway!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By some stroke of luck, we don't have work! So, Shizuku and I are gonna make the most of this trip!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, please do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And please bring souvenirs if you can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course. We'll also need to make sure to buy some for Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, enough of that!
Let's start practice!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay.

rows.Line: Yes, thank you!

Welcome back!

I wanna tell you all about it, but first...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ta-daaa! Souvenirs!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh wow! Matcha chocolates...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Close! Don't these upside-down triangles remind you of a certain fruit?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A certain fruit? Uhh...

rows.Line:

Strawberries♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Also, I got you some okaki crackers.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo☆ Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe. I bet her jaw's gonna drop when I tell her that we ran into Tenma and Kamishiro.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, but they'll probably tell her, and I don't wanna keep her too long...)

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Hi, Airi! I knew it was you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I thought I heard your voice just now! It's really nice to see you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You too, Saki.
Your timing couldn't have been better.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I got you some souvenirs!
I already gave the trio in Class A theirs. These are for you two.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow...! Okaki and langues-de-chat! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, do you have some time to talk after this? I wanna hear all about you guys' trip!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, me too! I wanna hear!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Since Saki's here, I might tell them that story.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure. There's actually something I wanna tell you two.

rows.Line: You might've heard already, but we ran into Saki's big brother and Kamishiro while we were in Kyoto.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaaaaat?!?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa told me about that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I knew that you guys would be going on the same day, so I was wondering if you'd bump into each other...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, we couldn't believe it either.
You should've heard the way Shizuku shouted when she saw who it was.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And that was Tsukasa?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Asahina was with us and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whaaat?! A-A-Asahina was with you guys too?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We were in the same tour group, so we decided to do some sightseeing together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After that, we looked for souvenirs together, and later met up with Kamishiro's friends that evening to see the Hyakki Yako parade.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I heard about the parade!
Did you hear, Emu? It was supposed to be really amazing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, I haven't!
Can you tell us more, Airi?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have plenty of time, so let me start from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, there's the bell...
Sorry, I tried to cover as much as I could.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, it was a great story!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And thank you for showing us all your pictures!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome!
Anyway, I should head back to my classroom.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! And thank you for the snacks!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I'll share mine with Nene and the others!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Our school trip was fun, but giving souvenirs to everyone like this is also really nice.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (For the first time in a while, it feels like I went on a real vacation.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm so glad I could go.

rows.Line:
Isn't this place great?

rows.Line:
Whoa, hold up.

I know.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Very true.
So, Ena, thank you for inviting us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and sorry for flip-flopping on you so suddenly. I really didn't think we could go at first.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, that's totally fine.
The appointment you had today got postponed, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, they had to call it off because one of the other personalities apparently had a scheduling conflict.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. That means we should thank our lucky stars. We left this day open just in case.

rows.Line: Welcome. Here's some water to start. Please press the button once you're all ready to order.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, why do you keep staring at all the staff...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I really like their uniforms. They're so cute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Dress shirts and aprons are pretty standard, but how cute are those ribbon ties?

rows.Line: What do you mean? Striped ribbons don't seem all that out of the ordinary to me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, but theirs are all a little different to each other. Some are gathered, while others have a bit of lace on them!

rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Your eyes are so sharp, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. I always keep an eye out for cute uniforms♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, I'm not sure how I feel about you staring at them the way you have...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, don't make it sound like I'm some sort of weirdo. I'm simply appreciating their fashion choices.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of cute uniforms, the ones from that other cafe were also really adorable!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Other cafe...? Oh, do you mean the one where Minori works?

rows.Line: If you're talking about pale blue dress shirts, white aprons and blue ribbon ties, then yes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've always wanted to try on a cute uniform like the ones they wear. Even if it's just once.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, why not just start working at a cafe?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
True, but I love clothes in general♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean. It must be nice to be surrounded by the things you love.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, how was it?
Did you enjoy working while wearing that uniform?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've got no complaints about the uniform! It was so comfortable!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I also enjoyed working here.
Things did get a little crazy there for a second, but decorating parfaits and stuff was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But things did get pretty hectic back there... So hectic that they didn't get to take any real breaks...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Mizuki got to wear this uniform and is gonna get paid, so that's technically two birds with one stone, but...)

rows.Line: Airi...? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, just us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We haven't done anything together yet just by ourselves, right? So, what do you say?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd love to! That sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: My schedule's pretty open, so just let me know when you wanna hang out! That day's totally fine too. I'm usually awake around noon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Great! I'll be looking forward to that♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? Airi, Mizuki, have either of you tried this pasta yet? It's very good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, we were talking so much that we forgot about the food.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go dig in!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I really didn't expect it to come together so smoothly. I wouldn't have set aside the whole of the day after tomorrow if I knew that it would.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I shouldn't speak for Shizuku and the others...

rows.Speaker: Airi

rows.Line:

rows.Line: No, I should be thanking you for helping me pick out that outfit♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're so good at using accent colors and finding a nice balance, Airi!

rows.Line: Hehe. As an idol, I need to have an eye for these things. I read a lot of fashion magazines to gain all of that knowledge.

rows.Line: Yeah, that makes a lot of sense!

rows.Line: Also, you really know how to find the best deals.

rows.Line: We just saw a similar outfit at a shop on Main Street, but you made sure to keep looking around since you knew there was a similar shop here too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, I like to see what all my options are if I'm set on getting something.

rows.Line: As a result, I was able to get this outfit at a more reasonable price compared to that other shop.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's so smart!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't think there's anything wrong with that since it's sort of like love at first sight, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, also... We've done a lot of walking without taking any breaks. Do you feel tired at all?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm fine. These shoes I'm wearing are really comfy, and we had a quick break when we got those crepes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, it's been so long since I last visited so many shops all at once. Ena always wants to take a break after going to a couple.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: On the flip side, she knows where all these great cafes are, so I get to see a lot of new things.

rows.Line: Hehe. Whenever I go shopping with Shizuku, I always have to make sure she doesn't wander off and get lost.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we do sometimes get lucky by stumbling across new shops wherever she ends up. So everything works out in the end.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! I love how shopping trips can feel so different depending on who you go with.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I'm really glad that we got to do this today, Airi!

rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Line: Now, if you've still got some gas left in the tank, wanna check out some of the shops on the other side of the station?

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Then, shall we?

rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: What do you all think?

rows.Line: C'mon...

rows.Line: There's no way I wouldn't be in!

rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to join as well. Saki is always looking after Shii, after all.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Thanks, everyone.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Hehe. You're so full of motivation, Airi.

rows.Line: (That made me really happy.)

rows.Line: (Back then... I wasn't able to see the Happy Everyday version of myself as an idol who gave people hope.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Because of what she said, I was able to think of myself as someone who'd managed to deliver hope...)

rows.Line: And every time we've met since, she's told me what she thought of our streams and all that, so she's been a great source of encouragement!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
