I wanna make this the best show possible so I can give Saki lots of hope and energy!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
I'll do my absolute best to make sure Saki enjoys it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, shall we talk through the details of the show before our practice?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Where should we begin... As well as the time and date, we'll also want to decide the set list soon considering the practice we'll need to do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Then, how about we include an Airi solo?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If my favorite idol sang a solo just for me... I'm confident I would pass out from the joy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What kind of confidence is that...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still, you're right...
If it'll make Saki happy, I want to do it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll try to make a list of songs that Saki might like, so I want all of your opinions too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, for the location, I'm sure Saki's also busy with her band practices, so I'm thinking it'd be best to do it here at school...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe, seems like things are going to get busy.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm gonna do my best to make sure Saki accomplishes what she wanted to do in the best way possible!)
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, I'd better call it there for stretches and get started on my homework.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, but first...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think I'll take a look at the letter and pictures I got from Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes!
I finally finished my album the other day, and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was thinking, it's thanks to all the people around me that I was able to make enough memories this year to fill up an album!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanted to thank you for that and for helping me with my list, so I brought gifts!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like Saki finished off her list, and I'm so glad! I can't wait to see what photos she chose for me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... This is from our chocolate fondue party.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And this one's from the time we made chocolate treats for Valentine's Day! Hehe, that takes me back...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, she wrote about her memories of when each picture was taken in the letter, right? What does it say...?

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “When it comes to my memories with you, I couldn't leave out Valentine's Day!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “You were sooo helpful and cool when we made chocolate desserts together!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “Your easy-to-understand baking lessons were one thing, but your ad-libbing also saved us when that unexpected trouble came up!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe, that's right.
It was pretty bad when Shizuku, Ichika and Tsukasa came to her house while we were there making our desserts.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We sure did panic that our surprise was about to be ruined!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's nice having this letter since it helps me remember a lot of stuff while I look at the picture.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This is such a wonderful gift.
I'll have to thank Saki again later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still... At this point, it really feels like this is the group when it comes to anything chocolate.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, maybe I'll invite them to make desserts using a different type of chocolate next time♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see, the next picture is... Oh, this is from that show we did.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is a great picture of the two of us! I'm glad!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The part of the letter for this photo is... Oh, here?

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “This picture of you and me after your concert! I was so happy!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “Airi, thank you so much for putting on a concert just for me!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “Getting to see the idols I follow perform made me suuuper happy!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You needed that many exclamation points?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, I guess she enjoyed it just that much.

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “I'd always wanted to go see one of your concerts...”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “I told you this before, but back when I was in the hospital, seeing you on TV cheered me up so much!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “Even though I couldn't spend time with my friends, I was never lonely when I was watching TV...”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “And Happy Everyday gave me courage with the way she worked hard to make everybody smile, so I was able to push through my awful medical tests!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “So, I wanted to cheer you on in person for giving me so much hope... And that's why I wanted to go to one of your concerts!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So the reason you put going to one of my concerts on your list was so you could cheer me on...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “The other day, I was so incredibly moved that I didn't really manage to cheer for you...”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “But! I'm going to keep cheering for you a whole lot to make up for that!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “Because now that I've seen you perform live, I love you and MORE MORE JUMP! more and more than ever!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “Thank you for always giving me so much hope!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line:
“Airi, you're so kind, so cute, so cool, and I'll always be your fan!
Love, Saki”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm so grateful.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm the one who needs to be thanking you.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I mean...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's thanks to people like you, who tell me that I've given you hope... As long as I have you... As long as we have you, we can keep doing our best.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And to make sure I'll always remain the idol you love...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright! I'm gonna keep doing my best tomorrow!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Morning, Minori.
Were you about to start stretching?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You seem a little down...
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So...
There is something that's been bothering me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, let's talk about it.
Shizuku and Haruka aren't here yet anyway.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? Then...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The teacher for the animal caretaker committee asked me to teach some of the first-years how to look after the rabbits.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, right... We talked about that, and you practiced giving your instructions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... The teacher even said that I'm the perfect person because I did such a good job last year.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I asked everyone for their advice, practiced what I'm gonna say and was really excited about this opportunity...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm starting to feel really nervous...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hang on. How'd things go for you in junior high? Weren't you also on the animal caretaker committee back then?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was, but the teacher did most of the instructing. The students usually just gave quick demonstrations...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, Minori, this isn't like you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Where's your usual, “Let's break through!” mantra?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But... I don't wanna break anything!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Taking care of the rabbits is a really important job. And...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm not just any second-year now...
I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have to think that some of the first-years are going to see me as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Which is why...
I feel that I need to not disappoint them by staying cool and setting a good example.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haha...
Maybe I sound kinda conceited since I'm still getting on my feet as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
The point you brought up matters a lot.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, you're an idol now. You're Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP! That's a fact.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, I do think you're overthinking this a bit...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It is important to see yourself as an idol, but you also need to keep in mind that you're at school.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You should be teaching your junior not just as an idol, but also as an experienced member of the animal caretaker committee.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: An experienced member of the committee...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, you know a lot about taking care of the rabbits and getting them to like you, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Some of them might be really curious since it could be their first time being on such a committee.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Although, a couple could be there because they lost a game of rock paper scissors or something.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But the rabbits are so cute!
I'm sure they're gonna love taking care of them...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, learning to like the rabbits could help them enjoy being on this committee!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Finally! There's our usual Minori!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's the spirit, Minori!
Try thinking more along those lines!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for listening, Airi!
I'm gonna do my best to show them the ropes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'm sure you'll do just fine.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 3-E

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Morning, Momoi, Hinomori.
Oh, wait, it's already past noon...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Are you all done with work?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we rushed over after realizing that we might be able to make afternoon classes.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: That's so admirable. I probably would've gone straight home.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, there aren't many others here today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They might be getting lunch.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Some are, but a lot have work this afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. The teacher said we'll be doing badminton instead of volleyball for P.E. later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Thanks for the heads up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Lunch doesn't end for a little bit...
Wanna study while we can, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes...
Then, let's go over what we'll be doing in English today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, good idea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just the same old, same old...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Go to work, then to school, study together... It's like nothing's changed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: At the same time, I think that's a good thing since getting used to a new routine is always difficult for me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Really...?
I kinda wish we had more going on.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're in our final year, but it's just business as usual, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Maybe I should've joined a committee or something like Shizuku.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Airi, have you had a chance to visit the tea ceremony club?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Now that you mention it, no...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Then, why don't you go?
New students will be visiting soon, yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, right...! Then I probably should!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I could ask you the same thing, Shizuku. You haven't been by the archery club yet, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I haven't. I was planning on going the next time we're not scheduled to work.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Now we both have something to look forward to.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, we should be focusing on English right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry. After suggesting that we should study...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's okay. We still have time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I also enjoy talking with you at school like this, so I wouldn't mind if we continued.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, hold your horses. I'm sorry for getting sidetracked, so let's get back to studying...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Seriously, nothing's changed since we were placed in the same class during our first year...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We study together, talk about what's going on at school...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I guess it's just our daily routine.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (If anything's changed, I'd have to say...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (How we're members of the same idol group now.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Airi...
Can you tell me what this idiom means?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: W-We're doing idioms?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I have a pretty good grasp of vocab now, but I haven't really been looking at idioms and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, why don't we try focusing on those whenever we study English together from now on?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that might be a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we need to go over what we're gonna cover in class today! Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right!
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Okay, I'm all done with my homework...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That just leaves...the file I was working on for our next meeting. I think I'll call it a night after finishing that up. I'm pretty sure I saved it in—)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Who's sending me an email at this hour? Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, an official offer to appear on that program!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's just one appearance, but this is TV we're talking about. Thank goodness too, since we were hoping that we'd get it.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
They even included a schedule.
Okay, shoot date's the same as we discussed...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, it's supposed to end at...?
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We get to do another on-site shoot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And this one's for a camping special! What do you think we're gonna do?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope we get to spend the night in tents. That sounds like so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... The schedule they sent over said they want to do everything in one day. I'm not sure we'll be spending the night...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, doesn't that mean we get to camp during the day?! That also sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it does.
But it's very far away, and the shoot's supposed to end in the evening. Going there and back may prove a bit challenging.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Heh heh heh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Airi...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That brings me to my spectacular solution...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why don't we go stay somewhere for this shoot?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Stay somewhere?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup. Shizuku's right about going there and back in one day being tough. When I was looking at this schedule yesterday, I remembered something really important...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They asked us to keep three days open just in case the shoot doesn't move forward as scheduled, so we have nothing going on during the days before and after.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which means we can take this opportunity to stay somewhere nice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We've been super busy lately, right?
Wouldn't it be nice to refresh ourselves with a little vacation...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yes! I wanna stay somewhere!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Me too!
This is so exciting! We hardly ever get to do that outside of training camps.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: True. And I agree with Airi about how busy we've been lately. Some rest and relaxation would be nice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's what I like to hear!
Then, let's all decide on a place to stay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Where might be good?
Do you think searching on any of the travel sites will help?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We have to keep our shoot in mind, so somewhere close would be ideal.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. We can try looking for places near this campground and... Oh, that's a lot of results.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's not just hotels! Fancy inns too!
So many choices! Which do we choose?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, this one has rooms with outdoor baths attached! I could spend a whole day in a room like this...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hold your horses.
Don't forget that we're going for work.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The shoot still comes first! The R&R's just an added bonus.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Right!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, how about this place?
It's close to the campground, and the views this room has to offer look spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Lemme see... Wait, this is a suite with a view of the mountains! This is way out of our budget!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It does offer some amazing views. It's on the top floor after all...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Haruka, do you have any suggestions or requests? Anything you want included or places you wanna go?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Me? No, nothing in particular...
But it might be a nice change of pace to stay at an inn since we'll get to experience something out of the ordinary.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, like wearing yukatas and having meals brought to our room... That definitely would be a special experience!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: An inn, huh...? I'll try filtering the results for just those. Gimme a sec...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, how about this one?
It's got pretty much everything that we want, and there's a big hot spring on site.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Not only that, it seems to have such a lovely atmosphere. I think...“warm” is the word I'm looking for.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The food in these pictures also looks really amazing! Is this one meal?! I dunno if my tummy can handle all that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And it looks like they have rooms big enough for all four of us. Why don't we try staying here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds like a plan! I'll see if they have any rooms open.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We get to stay at an inn...
Oh, this means we can have ice cream together after we take a bath!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That sounds like fun!
It said the inn's right by a river, so it'd also be nice to go out for a walk.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good idea. A nature walk sounds really refreshing and a nice way to stretch our legs.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I feel like it's been a little while since we all got so excited about something other than work.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(We've been super busy lately...
So we should try to make the most of these sorts of opportunities.)
Aboard a train

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
It's still gonna take a while to get where we're going.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(I know.
Maybe we could use this time to see if that schedule I shared with everyone yesterday looks okay.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, every—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I was hoping that we could check over that schedule I sent you all yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I guess these two can't right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're fast asleep.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We have been pretty busy lately.
I'd rather not wake then, so maybe we can look over our schedule after we get to the inn.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, it's a shame that they're sleeping instead of seeing this beautiful scenery...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right!
It's so beautiful... Nothing but green as far as the eye can see...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've gotta post a picture of this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hmm... What should I go for? More of a full landscape or a pic that includes the window to let everyone know we're traveling...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, or a shot of our reflections in the—)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi, look this way for me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, hey! You could've warned me before taking that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I thought everyone online would like seeing us in our natural state.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I get what you mean...
But submit it for approval first. Idols still have to be idols even in their “natural state”!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Submit it for approval...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, you're not posting that.
Our next one's gonna look a lot better. So, Haruka, smile!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, one second. Ready?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, not bad!
Let's go with this one!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since we're uploading both, I'll also send you the other one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, I said we're not uploading that one!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh... We got another email for work.
Come to think of it, we still have a few that we haven't replied to yet.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Need any help?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for offering, but I'm okay for now. I'll just reply to the most urgent ones.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That being said, it has been getting hard lately to actually deal with everything all on our own.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (As nice as it is that we're getting all these offers, dealing with scheduling has been hard on all of us...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (So, we really could use a manager.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Anyway, I'm gonna reply to all the emails that need my attention right now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi, are you all finished?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, for now.
Were you reading a book just now, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, it's a novel that one of our fans recommended. I was hoping to share my thoughts on it during a stream in the future.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, a novel...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm pretty close to finishing it, so want to borrow it once I'm done? It's actually pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I am interested, but I'll pass for now.
Reading for too long on a moving train might make me sick.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Haruka, do you not get motion sickness or anything? You seemed pretty focused just now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, now that you mention it, I don't really get motion sickness or anything. Even when I was still in ASRUN, I read scripts during our rides over...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I remember going through fan mail while on buses for shoots. That usually gave me all the motivation I needed to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow... I guess that means your inner ear's tough to agitate.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Still, it's really like her to think of her fans even during a bus ride.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Um, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not letting you hog the spotlight during this shoot!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I wouldn't want you to.
Let's make it a good one.
Satellite Puroland - Green Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's almost time...
Are we all ready?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's be sure to make “Cookie Baking Excitement With My Melody and MORE MORE JUMP!” a success so we can spread hope to everyone here at Puroland.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But wow, this has been such a surprise!
We're at a satellite park, but I still never thought we'd get to stand on a Sanrio Puroland stage with the one and only My Mel!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well, it was originally supposed to be Nanamin and them appearing.
We got the call last-minute because they ended up not being able to make it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Apparently Hayakawa recommended us as their replacements.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That means a lot to us.
It shows that she trusts us to take her place.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Definitely. Nanamin and all the staff have placed their trust in us, so let's make this event great for them too!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
MORE MORE JUMP!, you're up!
Please take the stage!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, we'll be right there!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, let's go!
Wisdom Tree Stage

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone!
I'm so happy to see all these friends here to see me today♪

rows.Speaker: Child A
rows.Line: Oh, it's starting!

rows.Speaker: Child B
rows.Line: My Mel's sooo cute...!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you♪

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
So, everyone, I've actually made some new friends.
Here, I'll introduce them to you!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP!, over here!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't give up on your dreams, Minorinrin♪ Here's a bouquet of hope for you!
I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No matter how far, may this song of hope reach you!
I'm Haruka Kiritani from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One special delivery of love coming right up!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's the lovely fairy, Airi! Airi Momoi from MORE MORE JUMP! at your service!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Here to bring you a burst of happiness. I'm Shizuku Hinomori from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's wonderful to meet all of you♪

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Ooh, clappity clap clap!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: So, everyone, MORE MORE JUMP! and I actually baked some cookies together the other day.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Baking together was more fun than doing it alone, and I got even closer with everyone in MORE MORE JUMP! that way♡

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: The cookies turned out more and more delicious too♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. So, we were talking about how we want to bake with everyone who's here today.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Mhm♪
Will you all help us bake some cookies?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Yaaay♪

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Okay then, let the cookie baking excitement...♪

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Begin♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Next, we mix up the dough!
The idea is to use a rubber spatula and fold in the ingredients ten times or so♪

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Okay♪ Mixy mixy... Huh?
I forget how many times that was...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, it's fine to go a little over or under.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Another five times or so should be good.
This time, let's all try counting together while we do it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here we go, everyone! Ready...? One, two, three...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Next, we'll flatten the dough out!
We need to take this rolling pin and make everything even... Do you think you could do that, My Mel?

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Sure!
Huff... Huff... Phew.
The pin is heavy, so this is kind of tiring.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Making treats definitely takes some energy.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Yeah... But I think I can keep trying if everyone does it with me♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then let's all get rolling and cheer My Mel on!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's all do the rolly dance together♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'll start us off.
Put your hands out a little bit in front of you. Now extend them... And pull back. Extend... Pull back.
That's how we do it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Did you all get it?
Then let's do it together! Ready...
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The event was a huge success!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm glad everyone seemed to have fun making treats with My Mel!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They got really into helping out and were talking about how cute she is the whole time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
She really was cute.
I like her even more after doing this event together♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah. She's true to her feelings and has a bright disposition...
She kinda lives at her own pace sometimes, but there's something lovely about that too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If she was part of the idol world, she'd probably be a tough rival.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, that's true.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh yeah. Before we leave today, would it be okay if we stopped by the Entrance Shop?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I took a peek earlier and saw they were selling all kinds of adorable treats and stuff, so it's been on my mind...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure. We're already here, so let's stop by.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want to see it too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay!
Entrance Shop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hmm... Oh, there he is! It's Tuxedosam!
I've been wanting a plushie of him.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
So this rabbit's name is Wish me mell.
It's very cute how the pads on her feet are shaped like hearts...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ooh...! They have Kirimichan. keychains!
Hehe, so cute!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, huh?!
On the tag, it says her dream is to have someone eat her and appreciate how delicious she is!
I-I could never do that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's going on with Minori, standing there flailing her arms around like that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm curious, but I should be thinking about what to get as a souvenir.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (These cookies have My Mel printed on them...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It'll be kind of a shame to eat them since they're so cute... But we baked cookies together on stage, so these are the perfect way to remember today.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've decided! I'll go with these.
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm so glad today's event went well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've gotta keep up the good work so even more people get to know us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still... My Mel really was amazing.
The way she talked and her dancing were so cute it felt unfair.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh... That reminds me, I bought those My Mel cookies as a souvenir.
Maybe I'll try some.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I thought I heard singing just now...
Was it coming from my phone?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I definitely hear it.
That's odd, nothing should be playing... Are Miku and the others putting on a show or something?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll drop in to take a look.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh? Nobody's here...
Then, that voice was...
Hmmmhmhm, hmmm♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... It sounds like it's coming from this ball of light.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What is this?
It feels like I've seen it somewhere before...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And this voice, could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wha... Huh?!
Where am I?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was in SEKAI until just a second ago, wasn't I...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Those people over there... Is that Minori and the others?!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Oh! Airiii!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So you're here too, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes. And just where is here...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
We just arrived as well...
But we were just talking about how it feels a bit like Puroland.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... Now that you mention it, it does...
Hm hmhm hmhmmm♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Did you hear a voice just now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I did. I was following this voice when I somehow ended up here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We might be able to get some ideas for how to get home, so let's head toward the voice!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Over there, that's...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My Mel?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd thought just maybe it could be her, but to think that she's actually here...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But what is she doing?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
This is just a guess, but... Don't you think she's making cookies?
Look, she's got some sort of dough under a roller.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're right. Plus... Doesn't this place remind you of the stage where we did that event with her?
Even the set is identical.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-It is...!
What does it all mean...?

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Hmmmhm, hmmm♪
Extend... Pull back. Rolly rolly roll...

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Phew... I sure am tired.
Time to take a little break♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Looks like she's having a hard time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, everyone. Why don't we go help My Mel?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I don't think I'll be able to leave her to it...
And while we're at it, let's see if she knows anything about this place she can share.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds good. Let's talk to her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Heeey, My Meeel!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Phew...
Now we just wait for them to bake in the oven♪

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Thanks for helping me, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
There's no need to thank us.
I like making treats too, so this was fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And thank you for telling us about this place, My Mel.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You said this is a SEKAI born from the feelings of wanting to visit Puroland again and thinking about how fun it was, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If that's the case, I can certainly understand why it resembles Puroland so much.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone. Would you like to have a tea party while we wait for the cookies to bake?
I have some really yummy tea♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That would be lovely! We got this chance to meet, so let's have a nice long chat!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Okay, here you are♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Wow, it smells so good!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, My Mel, why were you baking cookies?

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: So I can give them to my precious friend♪

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: So, I handed out the cookies to all my friends the other day... But I was short one for her, so she and I had to split one.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: That's why I'm making lots and lots this time, so she can eat her fill!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So that's why...
You care for your friends very much, My Mel.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Oh... But, I've always loved to bake cookies.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: My dream is to get much, much better so I can open a dessert shop and make everybody happy with my treats.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. That's a truly wonderful dream.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Thank you♪
What are your dreams?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're working really hard to become idols who give people hope for a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Wow, what a wonderful dream.
I'll be cheering for you!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: You're all so cute and dazzling, so I think you'll be able to give people lots of hope♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe, thank you.
But I think you're also very cute and dazzling, My Mel.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Am I?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I think so too!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Hehehe...♪

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: So cute...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Th-This is against the rules...!)

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: They're finished!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm glad they appear to have come out well.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Yeah♪ Now to give them a taste.
*Blow*
*Munch*

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Wow, it's so delicious♪
Here everyone, you should try them too♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll have one.
Oh, this really is delicious! I'm sure your friend will be delighted.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Actually, Airi, you kind of remind me of my friend.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I do?

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Mhm. She's super sweet, just like you♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe, well thank you!
I'm happy to hear you say that.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Hey, I want to talk with all of you some more, so... How about we have another tea party, with cookies this time?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
But didn't you say these cookies are for your friend?

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: There's a whooole lot, so it'll be okay if we eat a little bit♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well then, I think we'd like to take you up on that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I want to talk with you more too, My Mel.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Tell us lots about your friend, too!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Okay♪
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
It's so nice out today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, having dance practice outside is going to feel so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but we have something else to take care of first.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The debrief for the shoot we did the other day?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes! We need to do that before it slips our minds.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, to be fair, it's only been three days.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I mean, so much stuff happened.
First, we were asked to fill in for another group, and then there was that issue with the cameras during the shoot.

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Technical difficulties... Missing forty minutes of footage puts us in a tough situation.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm surprised this kind of thing happened at a TV studio during a shoot...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. I've heard of stuff like this happening, but this is my first time actually being on site as it did...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is the stuff of nightmares to the camera crew since such a simple mistake can cascade into fairly serious problems for the show.

rows.Speaker: Yuika
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm not so sure about this now...
We're going to sound really phony if we're not careful...

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line: The packaging for everything that I brought in has been opened up. Worse, we went through most of what we had. They're in our stomachs now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Honestly, I didn't know how we were gonna get through that one...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But we managed to in the end.
And we have Minori to thank for coming up with a replacement idea.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Including the producer and the rest of the crew. They couldn't stop thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To tell you the truth, Minori, I was a little worried about you then...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Remember how you pulled out all the stops after the break? You really helped get a good thing going for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I was worried that you were feeling crushed after hearing how they didn't record any of it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: My plan was to cheer you up as best I could, but I'm glad I didn't have to in the end.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Airi...!
You were that worried about me...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, just a tiny bit.
Also, personal space. Quit inching closer like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I was also a little worried.
After the break, you seemed to do whatever you could to make things more entertaining for the audience.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Did something happen during the break?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, so...

rows.Speaker: Audience Member Ａ
rows.Line: I was really looking forward to seeing LiLia here today. I mean, that's why I applied to be a member of the audience.

rows.Speaker: Audience Member Ｂ
rows.Line:
Oh, they're overseas right now.
Apparently, they're having trouble flying back due to bad weather.

rows.Speaker: Audience Member Ｂ
rows.Line: But I still wish LiLia were here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There was probably no way we could've made up for LiLia not being there...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I still wanted the audience to go home smiling and filled with encouragement!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why'd you go and do everything by yourself?! Seriously, you should've roped us in!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Owwy!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Airi, that hurts!
I was so sure you were going to praise me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I did just a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I was wondering why you were trying so hard. This explains everything.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, Airi, there's no point in getting mad at her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I know.
But she shouldn't have kept us in the dark!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But I didn't have time to tell you!
Our break ended so fast...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't tell me there's something else you forgot to tell us...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Uhh... Y-Yes, there is...
So...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our landlady was at the studio?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. Remember how she was on her way to see a shoot when we helped her? She was there to see another one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. She must love TV just that much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyway, she said she overheard what the audience was saying, and was really worried...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I felt so much better after talking to her. I was able to clear my thoughts, figure out what's most important and do my best after the break...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, I'm guessing that's everything...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, that's everything!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is that why she's taken such an interest in us? Was she inspired by what Minori did...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You might be right.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? Oh, does that make me the MVP?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She said “might”.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (A house meant only for those who can make their dreams come true.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Our landlady couldn't have asked for a better fit.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Welcome, everyone.
Thank you for stopping by to clean today.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Still, I wish I had more time. I would've asked a cleaning service to send someone over...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, that's okay since we asked if we could move in as soon as possible!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I'm on my school's animal caretaker committee, so cleaning is my forte!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, and I used to be on the cleanup committee. We promise to do our best today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I get the cleanup committee, but what does taking care of animals have to do with this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everything! We have to work quickly but discreetly in order to keep the rabbits from getting too scared!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane and Hinomori also mentioned that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They really admire how efficiently you're able to clean the cage.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? In that case, we'll be counting on you today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's do our best to make this place shine!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Can you reach all the really high places using the feather duster, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I think so.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You'll probably want to wear a mask.
I'd rather not have you breathe in that dust.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here, put this on.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Airi.
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mind if I use that floor wiper you brought, Airi? I want to try using it on the screen door.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, but do you know how to clean a screen door?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How? Does that mean it's not a good idea to just wipe it down?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
See how it's a big mesh?
There's a trick to cleaning this kind of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, Shizuku, can you two take care of this? I'm gonna go help Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Next up is the kitchen!
Let's start with the hardest part, the ventilation.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, we'll need something to catch anything that comes out! We can use some of this newspaper!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, that's perfect! You sound like a pro, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can you get us some hot water, Haruka, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: On it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...! It's so clean now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, including the floors and windows! They're sparkling!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now we can move in without a second thought!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You and Airi did a great job of leading, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. It seemed like you both knew exactly what to do every time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Again, being on the animal caretaker committee has taught me a lot!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I didn't see you hesitate once.
I have no choice but to say that you being a member of the animal caretaker committee helped a lot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But you were definitely way more amazing, Airi! I mean, you knew how to properly clean an air conditioner!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree... It took you so little time to take out the fans and filters.

rows.Speaker: Airi

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I think this cap with a bandana tied around it is one of its biggest selling points—

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Don't worry. You did your best, and it shows.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I was afraid that your explanation would get cut short since you did sorta go on for a bit...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Oh, really? I thought they'd leave it in since the audience was smiling and laughing the entire time.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Wow, that was great!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Yeah, it was! And we all appeared on camera.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <You said that we shouldn't get our hopes up too much, Airi, but I think we're all glad that you were wrong.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Same...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Our segment was one thing, but they also showed us a lot during the other talk segments and stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <My hope was that they'd include some of those portions since we got pretty good responses...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Oh, that reminds me...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Do you all remember what Mr. Arimura said before our shoot started back up?>

rows.Line: You get into a habit of drawing lines when you're in a studio like this, but the crew and personalities all want the show they're working on to be good. We all want the audience to enjoy themselves.

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line: Which is why it's so important to take a step back, forget the lines in the sand and remind ourselves of what the audience is feeling.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I remember...
But what's that got to do with us?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Yes, we saw ourselves as “replacements” when we were first given this offer.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <But Minori did her best and tried to bring as much fun to the show. All of the crew and guests also did the same, no?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I feel like we were accepted as real guests, which allowed us to put on a successful shoot. As a result, we've been receiving all these new offers...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Yeah, you're right!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <So, I did good?!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <You did. The results that you achieved clearly made you the MVP of that shoot.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <What?! The MVP...?!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Wait, I forgot! I was gonna post a message on social media once the show ended.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Let's go with... “Thank you to everyone who watched the show! Please use the hashtag and let us know what were your favorite parts!♪”>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Just gotta throw in my name at the end and... Send!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Oh, like what other idol groups do! Seeing your name at the end makes it look so official!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <That's the point. All of us gotta start doing this more so we can...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<No, I left my notifications on!
I need to turn the log off too...!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Phew. That was scary.
I wasn't expecting to receive a response so quickly...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<That was incredible.
I thought it was your phone's alarm there for a second.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Whoa! More and more people are replying to your post, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I guess means our appearance was a success.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Undoubtedly!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<And we have you to thank, Minori!
We couldn't have done it without you!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<R-Really?! Woohoo!
Airi praised me!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Hey, I get that you're happy, but don't come crying to me after your parents scold you for being so loud.>

...
